sentence: 我给同事的留言只写“明天早点来”，同事问：“是八点前吗？”我把时间讲清了：“请八点半到，不必八点前来，布置九点开始。”同事回答：“明白，你要我八点半到；我还得查一下明早的安排，稍后答复能不能来。”
meaning: clarify through explanation
grammar: 讲清 combines explaining with an achieved clear specification; it does not entail acceptance of the request.
register: Clarifying a practical request to a colleague.

sentence: 新成员问：“读书组怎么分担这次场地费？没来的人也交吗？”我把办法讲透了：“只由当天到场的四人平摊一百二十元，每人三十元；没来的人不交，饭费各付各的。若人数改变，先重新商量，不能直接照这个数收钱。”新成员准确复述了这些条件，但没有表示赞成或反对。
meaning: explain thoroughly; spell out fully
grammar: 讲透 describes thorough explanation of the specified matter, without entailing agreement.
note: 平摊: share a cost equally.

sentence: 原通知写：“周六九点到东教室画画，每人带纸。”我们确认每人要带两张白纸后，把要求写明了：“周六九点到东教室画画，每人带两张白纸。”活动、时间和地点都没有改，通知还没发出。
meaning: state explicitly in writing
grammar: 写明 takes the detail explicitly specified in the written text.

sentence: 草案原来写：“周日十四点在院子里交流一小时。”三位合办者又同意下雨时改到东教室，我把这项条件写入草案，修订为：“周日十四点交流一小时；不下雨在院子里，下雨改到东教室。”修订已经完成，现在仍是周五，活动尚未举行。
meaning: insert in writing into a text
grammar: 把某项条件写入草案 identifies the content inserted and its receiving text.
register: Recording an agreed contingency in a draft.

sentence: 小林在会上说：“我周五上午把三张照片送到东教室，只负责送照片，不负责布置。”我征得小林同意后，把这段话写成一条纪要：“小林承诺周五上午送三张照片至东教室，不承担布置工作。”现在是周四，送照片的事还没发生。
meaning: render in a specified written form
grammar: 把某段话写成某种文本 presents source content becoming a specified written form.
register: Preparing a meeting record from an authorized statement.
note: 纪要: a concise record of key meeting points.

sentence: 三位老师各交了一则课堂记录，内容分别是：“周一四人练习提问。”“周二六人练习复述。”“周三五人练习总结。”我按日期把这三则记录编成一份交流材料，正文依次保留了这三句话；目前只完成了草稿，还没有逐一向老师核实，也没有印发。
meaning: compile into a written whole
grammar: 把若干记录编成一份材料 describes assembling supplied parts into one text.
note: 印发: print and distribute.

sentence: 为让同事先看清待办事项，我在便签上罗列了四项：“确认教室、借六把椅子、印十份材料、通知参加者。”这张便签只供大家了解任务总目，没有写负责人和期限，还不能直接当作执行方案。
meaning: list; enumerate
grammar: 罗列 takes the items presented in an enumeration; evaluation depends on the purpose and context.
register: Neutral description of a preliminary task list.
note: 总目: an overall list of items.

sentence: 签收条写着：“周一十点，小林收书两本。”我周三才把这句话原样录入电子借阅记录，并另记“登记时间：周三”。周一已经发生的是收书，周三完成的是文字登记，小林并没有又收两本书。
meaning: enter text or data into a record
grammar: 把某段文字录入某项记录 identifies the entered content and receiving record.
register: Explaining the entry of an earlier transaction.
note: 签收条: a slip acknowledging receipt.

sentence: 交接便条只写：“把原稿交给负责登记的人。”我不知道该找谁，便问写便条的小周。小周指明了接收人：“交给小林；小林今天登记，我只负责核对数量。”我知道该找谁了，但原稿还在我手上，尚未交出。
meaning: identify explicitly; specify precisely
grammar: 指明接收人 means explicitly identifying who is to receive the item.
note: 原稿: the original manuscript or text.

sentence: 小林给我的回复是：“可以先试一次，长期合作的事等试过再谈。”这番话透出一种谨慎的态度。我问是不是反对合作，小林解释：“不是反对；我愿意试，但现在不想承诺长期参加。”第一次试办的日期还没有确定。
meaning: convey; reveal a discernible attitude
grammar: 话语透出某种态度 describes a stance conveyed by wording; the speaker's clarification establishes the intended stance here.
note: 试办: undertake an initial trial.

sentence: 我们约定，读书会方案要往前推进，必须先有教室、讲解人和六份材料。现在教室已借好，讲解人已答应，材料也已备齐。我对合办者说：“有这些条件，这个方案才推得动。”明天才开始通知参加者，活动还没有启动。
meaning: be possible to advance a plan
grammar: 推得动 extends attainable movement to advancing a plan under the specified enabling conditions.

sentence: 我主张这间教室的椅子数量够七人同时坐。小周质疑：“八把里面有一把坏了。”我答：“坏的已经拿走，剩下七把都试坐过，七人各坐一把正好。”小周承认数量上够；我据此说，这个关于座位数量的论证站得住，租金是否合适还要另谈。
meaning: stand up to the specified challenge, of an argument
grammar: 论证站得住 evaluates its ability to withstand the actual objection, within the stated scope.
note: 试坐: test a seat by sitting on it.

sentence: 三份材料的接收记录分别写着：“小林，八点四十；小周，八点五十；王安，八点五十五。”负责接收的人确认，这三条都是今天的实际接收时间。我判断，这些记录撑得住“三份材料都在九点前收到”这个结论，但不能说明材料已经读完。
meaning: be sufficient to support a specified claim
grammar: 记录撑得住某个结论 figuratively treats evidence as support for a claim of the stated strength.

sentence: 朋友向我借的二百元原定今天归还。我本想说“请你今天把钱还我”，也知道这句话怎么说，可听朋友说刚失去一份临时工作，又怕催得太急，这句话一直说不出口。最后我只说：“还钱的日期，我们明天再商量。”新的还款日期还没约定。
meaning: be unable to bring oneself to say something
grammar: 说不出口 expresses emotional inhibition about uttering the specified words, rather than lack of linguistic knowledge.
register: Owned difficulty in a familiar financial conversation.
note: The speaker postpones discussion without waiving repayment.

sentence: 三位出资人都要求听完整的收支说明，也同意在三人的讨论中公开这次账目。我在会上把账目摊开来说：“共收三百元，场地花一百八十元，材料花八十元，还剩四十元，没有其他收支。”大家听清了这些数，剩款用途仍未决定。
meaning: lay information openly before others for discussion
grammar: 把账目摊开来说 means openly presenting the relevant financial facts for discussion.
register: Open explanation to the authorized contributors.
note: 剩款: remaining funds.

sentence: 上月只有一组试用“先各自写问题，再轮流讨论”的办法。本月另外两组也各完成了两次同样的讨论，三组的记录都已交来。这项活动已在三组铺开，但第四组还没有决定参加，不能说全协会都已采用。
meaning: roll out an activity across a wider scope
grammar: 活动在若干组铺开 describes its actual extension across those groups.

sentence: 印刷店最初报总价一百五十元，其中送货三十元。我们商量后决定自己取件，店主确认免去送货这一项，印刷数量和纸张都不变。我终于把总报价压下来，定为一百二十元；这只是双方确认的报价，还没有付款。
meaning: bring a negotiated amount down
grammar: 把报价压下来 presents an achieved reduction from the explicit original level.
note: 取件: collect the completed items.

sentence: 本周原由两人核对十份记录，搭档临时请假后，我同意独自完成。我连着三晚逐份查完，并把发现的两处日期错误改正，算是把这周的核对任务扛下来了；汇总报告仍由负责人写，我也没有答应下周继续独自承担。
meaning: shoulder a demanding task through to a reached endpoint
grammar: 把某项任务扛下来 presents taking and sustaining its burden through an actual endpoint.
note: 搭档: a work partner.

sentence: 我们以前只口头说“发通知前最好再看看”，没有固定要求。今天全组通过新约定：“每份通知须由另一位成员核对日期和地点后再发，从今天起执行。”我们把先核对、后发布的规矩立起来了；新约定下的第一份通知还在核对，尚未发出。
meaning: establish a rule as an operative arrangement
grammar: 把规矩立起来 extends establishment to an actual agreed rule, rather than literal upright placement.
register: Conversational explanation of a newly adopted working rule.
note: 规矩: an agreed rule or expected procedure.

sentence: 筹备说明原先只有三条散记：“六人参加；每人带两张纸；先示范，再练习。”我把它们分别放在“参加者”“材料”“活动顺序”三个标题下，先把说明的框架搭起来了；具体时间和负责示范的人还没补上，整份说明尚未完成。
meaning: build a preliminary framework
grammar: 把框架搭起来 describes assembling an initial organizing structure from supplied components.
note: 散记: separate, unorganized notes.

sentence: 过去店员收下订餐单后，只把单子留在柜台，厨房不知道何时来取，常要等人再问。我们改为由店员收单后直接交给当班厨师，厨师当面核对数量。今天三张单都按这个办法交接完，终于打通了收单与备餐之间的信息传递环节；三份餐还在制作。
meaning: remove a barrier between linked work stages
grammar: 打通某个工作环节 describes establishing a functioning connection where a specified blockage existed.
note: 订餐单: meal-order form; 备餐: meal preparation.

sentence: 这次社区阅读活动原来只接受书面回忆，后来三位参与者提出也愿意提供照片。经本人同意，我们又收进六张照片，拓宽了材料范围；材料仍只用于这次组内交流，没有取得对外发表的许可。
meaning: broaden a defined range
grammar: 拓宽范围 describes actual broadening beyond the stated original inclusion.
register: Reporting a consented expansion of activity materials.

sentence: 讨论散场安排时，小林说：“两位成员八点得走，否则赶不上末班车。”为让他们不必提前离开，我提议：“我们把讨论定在八点结束，怎么样？开始时间选几点合适？”我用这条出行限制引出了开始时间的问题，大家随后提出六点和六点半两个选择，结束和开始的时间都尚未决定。
meaning: introduce a following topic through a preceding point
grammar: 用某一点引出某个问题 describes a discourse link to a newly raised question.
register: Explaining a transition within a planning discussion.
note: 末班车: the last scheduled bus or train.

sentence: 支出表写着：“纸张六十元，印刷四十元，合计九十元。”我先核对这处加法错误，查收据时又找到一张十元的交通费收据。付款人确认本次只有这三项支出，交通费在原表中漏记了。这次核对还牵出了一项漏记费用的问题；完整总额应是一百一十元。
meaning: bring a related issue to light during investigation
grammar: 核对牵出某个问题 describes a related issue emerging through the actual checking process.

sentence: 原分工是小林通知参加者，我联系送餐人。小周提议把活动从东教室改到西教室，我提醒：“这不只关系到发通知，还牵扯送餐地点的更改；如果大家同意换地方，我得把新地址告诉送餐人。”小周同意先征求全组意见，现在地点尚未改变。
meaning: involve a connected task within an issue's scope
grammar: 牵扯某项工作 identifies connected work affected by considering the proposed change.

sentence: 手册原定十点印好，十一点供讲解会使用；主办者事先确认，要等手册到齐才开始。打印机故障使手册到十一点半才送到，讲解会也因此改到十一点半开始。主办者在报告中写：“印刷延误波及了讲解会，其他活动的时间没有变。”
meaning: extend an adverse effect to another activity
grammar: 延误波及某项活动 describes its disruptive effect reaching that connected activity.
note: 手册: handbook; 讲解会: explanatory session.

sentence: 协会原来要求各活动组买任何材料都先请理事会决定。今天理事会通过新安排，从周一开始把每次一百元以内的材料采购决定权下放给各组组长；超过一百元的仍须报理事会。现在是周五，新安排还未开始执行。
meaning: delegate decision-making power to a lower organizational level
grammar: 把某项决定权下放给某人 specifies the delegated power, recipient and organizational direction.
register: Explaining a locally adopted delegation arrangement.
note: 理事会: the association's governing board; 采购: purchasing supplies.

sentence: 在这次活动的工作层级中，组长负责汇总材料缺口，并向上一级的活动负责人汇报；活动负责人有权安排补购。我作为组长，已把“现有八份，仍缺两份”的情况上报给活动负责人；消息发送成功，但对方尚未确认收到，也没有批准补购。
meaning: report to a higher responsible organizational level
grammar: 把情况上报给某位负责人 marks reporting through the explicitly established responsibility hierarchy.
note: 补购: purchase an additional required quantity.

sentence: 活动负责人有权给两位组长分配检查任务，今天向他们下达了同一项指令：“周五中午前，各自核对本组表格上的日期和地点，发现问题立即报告。”两位组长都已回复收到，但检查尚未开始，不能把接收指令写成任务完成。
meaning: issue an instruction through an established authority chain
grammar: 向某人下达指令 identifies the authorized issuer, receiving role and instruction.

sentence: 明天展览要用的六张桌子已经摆好，说明牌也都贴上了，只剩收走包装纸、擦净桌面两件事。我和小林又做了二十分钟，为今天的现场布置收尾，两件事都做完才离开；明天的接待工作还没有开始。
meaning: complete the final steps of a task
grammar: 为某项工作收尾 refers to its specified finishing steps rather than completion of a larger undertaking.
register: Reporting the end of a setup task.
note: 说明牌: explanatory display label.

sentence: 简报最初有两种结构：按日期分段，或按“进展、困难、下一步”分段。经过两次讨论，三位编写者今天都同意采用后一种，不再改栏目顺序，简报的结构就此定型；各栏的文字仍在修改，定下结构不等于全文写完。
meaning: become settled in form or structure
grammar: 结构定型 describes the form becoming settled after the stated deliberation.
note: 栏目: section or category in a publication.

sentence: 培训计划原来只有“教大家整理记录”这一句话。现在草案已有三部分：“示范分类、各自练习、共同核对”，每部分也列了要做的事。计划的框架已经成形，但每部分用时和指导人还没确定，尚不能据此通知开课。
meaning: take recognizable shape
grammar: 框架成形 marks emergence of a recognizable form without requiring finalized details.

sentence: 我们原定周六去邻镇参观书店，曾因车辆未定考虑取消。周五小林答应开车，周六九点我们三人已一起出发，这次参观终于成行。我在九点半写下这条消息时，车还在路上，尚未到书店。
meaning: take place as planned, of a trip
grammar: 行程或参观成行 means the planned outing actually goes ahead, rather than merely being booked or agreed.
note: 邻镇: a neighbouring town.

sentence: 负责人让我借周日下午两点到四点可用、能放八把椅子的教室。我已得到房主书面确认，这个时段可以借用，室内也有足够空间同时摆放八把椅子，借用单由双方确认完毕。这件事已经办妥；钥匙要到周日才领取，排练更没有开始。
meaning: complete an arrangement satisfactorily
grammar: 把某件事办妥 or 某件事办妥 describes satisfactory completion of the specified arrangement.
register: Reporting completion of a bounded venue arrangement.

sentence: 我周一答应小林：“周五中午前把两页活动说明发给你，附上费用表。”今天周五十一点，我已把两页说明和费用表一并发出，小林也确认收到。我兑现了这项承诺；另约的周日现场帮忙仍是未来的事。
meaning: fulfil an earlier commitment
grammar: 兑现承诺 links an actual completed act to the exact earlier commitment.
register: Reporting fulfilment of a specified promise.

sentence: 小林说旧说明牌的字太小，站在桌前看不清日期。我为让小林在同一位置读清日期，把字号放大，其他文字没改。小林试读后准确读出了日期，并说：“就是字变大后看清的。”这次调整奏效了，但还没有请其他读者试读。
meaning: produce the intended effect
grammar: 某项调整奏效 reports achievement of its specified intended effect in the actual case.
note: 字号: type size.

sentence: 三位合办者周五签下约定：“从下周一九点起，材料领用由小林登记，原登记人只负责交接旧记录。”现在已到周一九点十分，新分工已经生效；这只说明当前应由谁登记，不表示今天的材料已经有人领走。
meaning: take effect; become operative
grammar: 约定或分工生效 refers to its operative status at the agreed effective boundary.
register: Explaining the current status of a local working agreement.
note: 领用: collect supplies for use.

sentence: 这次活动的组织者与参加者事先约定：“旧取件卡今天中午十二点前可用，十二点起只认新卡。”现在下午一点，旧卡已经失效，不能再凭它领取材料；卡片仍完整保留，只是不再是这次领取材料的有效凭证。
meaning: cease to be valid for the specified use
grammar: 某张卡失效 means its specified validity has ended, without implying physical destruction.
register: Explaining a locally agreed collection-card replacement.
note: 取件卡: collection card; 凭卡: using a card as the collection credential.

sentence: 我们三人约好，小林统计人数，我核对金额，小周决定是否订餐。小林问我要不要顺便替小周下单，我回答：“按我们的分工，我该核对金额，不能替小周决定；金额今晚核完，订单仍等小周确认。”
meaning: ought to; should, under the agreed responsibility
grammar: 该 introduces the action required by the speaker's agreed responsibility; the checking remains future.

sentence: 周一上午十点，当我走进会议室时，小林正在整理六份材料；十点十分我开始介绍方案，小林随后把材料分给大家。
meaning: when; at the time that
grammar: 当……时 introduces the actual reference event against which the ongoing background action is located.
register: Organized spoken or written event account.

sentence: 这间教室有十二个座位，我们十人坐下后，椅子之间仍有空隙，两侧通道也能通行；关门后，外面的谈话声听不见。我在比较记录中写：“这间教室既宽敞又安静，符合我们对空间和声音环境的两项要求。”
meaning: both; introducing the first of two jointly true properties
grammar: 既……又…… coordinates two true properties of the same classroom; it does not introduce a reason.
note: 宽敞: spacious.

sentence: 早上整理资料时，我还以为只缺一张收据；及至下午把三个文件袋全部查完，我发现少的是两张，便把交接记录中的数量改成了两张。
meaning: by the time that; upon reaching the point when
grammar: 及至 introduces the later reached checking endpoint at which the earlier assessment is revised.
register: Written narrative; conversation can use 等到.

sentence: 同事问：“你负责检查，也负责批准付款吗？”我答：“我就负责检查这一项，批准付款归小林；我今晚把检查结果交给小林，付款还得等小林决定。”
meaning: only; restricting the stated responsibility
grammar: 就 restricts the speaker's assigned role to checking; it does not locate the action early or mark a conditional consequence.

sentence: 同事指着只有姓名的表说：“这就是完整的出席记录。”我拿出另一张同时写有姓名和到场时间的表，解释：“我们约定，完整的出席记录就是同时列有姓名和到场时间的表；按这个定义，这才是完整的出席记录，前一张只是姓名表。”
meaning: indeed; emphasizing the correct identification against an alternative
grammar: 这才是 emphasizes the criterion-supported identification that corrects the preceding label; it does not mean not until.

sentence: 我原以为给说明多加两页例子，读者会更容易找到答案；小林试读后却说：“例子太多，我找不到原来的步骤了。”我据此准备把例子移到后面，尚未改完。
meaning: yet; contrary to the stated expectation
grammar: 却 follows the subject 小林 and introduces a response contrary to the writer's stated expectation.

sentence: 小林问：“你昨天只是把三份材料收齐了吗？”我答：“我不光收齐了，还按日期排好了顺序；内容有没有错误，我还没核对。”
meaning: not only
grammar: 不光……还…… adds a second completed action by the same actor without including the unperformed content check.
register: Conversational explanation; 不仅 is a common written counterpart.

sentence: 昨天下午，两组就借用时段谈到五点，双方都明确拒绝了对方最后提出的时间，随后结束会谈，没有达成安排。我在记录中写：“本次协商未果；下周是否重新商谈，仍待双方回复。”
meaning: fail to achieve the intended result, after an attempt
grammar: 协商未果 reports the unsuccessful outcome of this completed negotiation attempt; it does not describe an unstarted attempt.

sentence: 六块展板的文字、图片和位置都已按约定排好，负责核对的小林也逐块确认无误。我在进度说明中写：“展板排版已经告成，接下来还要印刷、运输和安装，展览尚未开始。”
meaning: be successfully completed
grammar: 告成 predicates successful completion of the specified layout task, not the larger exhibition project.
note: 排版: arrange text and images into a layout.

sentence: 桌上的两本笔记本，蓝色那本是小林的，红色那本是小周的。散会收拾时，我提醒两人：“请拿各自的，别替对方收。”两人随后分别拿走了自己的笔记本。
meaning: each person's own, with the item understood
grammar: 各自的 functions as the object of 拿 with 笔记本 omitted; both owners and their respective notebooks are explicitly recoverable.

sentence: 小林问小周：“周五你能出席讨论吗？”小周答：“排班还没确认，能去或不能去都有可能，明晚再答复。”我在记录中写：“小周出席与否，须等明晚确认；目前不能记为答应，也不能记为拒绝。”
meaning: or not; whether the preceding predicate holds
grammar: 出席与否 places the affirmative-or-negative alternative after the predicate; 是否出席 places it before the predicate.

sentence: 东间教室已经获准借用，西间仍等负责人回复；西间若答应，两间都可用，若拒绝，就只有东间可用。同事问能否保证两间，我答：“两间未必都能借到，但东间已经确定；西间目前既没有答应，也没有拒绝。”
meaning: not necessarily all
grammar: 未必 takes scope over the universal claim 都能借到. The front leaves all-available and only-east-available outcomes open while guaranteeing the east room.
register: Careful qualification of a proposed arrangement.

sentence: 小林批准了八十元的材料支出，我按批准单把钱交给供应者，并登记了收款确认。交接时我说明：“这笔付款由我经手，批准人是小林；我办理了交付和登记，没有自行决定金额。”
meaning: handle a specified transaction or matter
grammar: 由某人经手 identifies the actual handler without itself assigning approval authority or ownership.

sentence: 白色打印机是摄影组购买并拥有的，黑色打印机是写作组购买并拥有的。我在借用清单上写：“两台机器分属摄影组和写作组，白色向摄影组借，黑色向写作组借。”两份借用请求都还没有答复。
meaning: belong respectively to different specified parties
grammar: 分属 relates a plural subject to different owners; the preceding colour-to-group pairings specify which machine belongs to which group.

sentence: 练习装置中，按钮通过细杆带动铃响。我按说明取下连接按钮和细杆的小扣，断开了这处连接；再按按钮，按钮仍能移动，细杆不再动，铃也不再响。
meaning: disconnect; separate an existing link
grammar: 断开 takes the affected connection as its object; the achieved separation is distinguished from continued movement of the button itself.
note: 小扣: a small fastening clip.

sentence: 送货单写“六箱”，接收记录却写“五箱”。接收人确认，这批收到的箱子全拍在两张签收照片中，每箱只拍了一次。我查看照片：第一张有四箱，第二张有另外两箱，每箱编号不同。我已把这批总数核清，是六箱；各箱里有多少本书，照片看不出，仍须另查。
meaning: establish clearly through checking
grammar: 核清 marks resolution of the stated total-count discrepancy, not discovery of the contents of every box.

sentence: 原稿先写“小周周三送来照片”，再写“小林周一拍照”，最后写“我周二选出六张”。编辑只把三句编排为“小林周一拍照—我周二选出六张—小周周三送来照片”，改的是呈现顺序，人物、日期和事件都没有变。
meaning: arrange material into a specified order
grammar: 把三句编排为…… specifies the resulting presentation order without changing the events' actual chronology or actors.

sentence: 小林的原信写：“周五我能来帮忙。若六点仍未下班，就不能到场。下班后我会再确认。”我从信中截取了后两句：“若六点仍未下班，就不能到场。下班后我会再确认。”这段仍署小林的名字，没有把未确认的到场写成保证。
meaning: extract a selected part from a whole
grammar: 从信中截取…… identifies both the source whole and the selected wording; the quotation preserves the condition and pending confirmation.

sentence: 这次借书记录的原件由我放在办公室的蓝色文件夹中留存，到十月三十一日核对完全部归还情况后，再交给小林整理；今天只发给同事一份副本，原件没有移交。
meaning: retain; keep on file
grammar: 留存 predicates retention of the original record by the named custodian at the stated location for a bounded checking purpose.
note: 原件: original document; 副本: copy.

sentence: 小组希望周六有二十人参加，但登记表上只有十二个名字，其中十人已确认、两人尚未回复。负责人提醒写报告的我：“要实事求是，把登记数和确认数分开，不能把希望的人数写成已经到场的人数。”
meaning: base one's account or judgment on the actual facts
grammar: 要实事求是 introduces the requirement to keep the stated report faithful to its actual evidence.
register: Serious discussion of reporting, judgment or conduct.
note: A chengyu emphasizing a factual basis. The attendance remains future; even confirmed intentions are not recorded arrivals.

sentence: 东院有空地，居民把交换桌摆在院内；西院通道窄，居民商量后把桌子放进已有借用许可的活动室，留出通道。两处总结写：“布置要因地制宜，同样是旧书交换，摆桌位置可以根据场地条件调整。”
meaning: adapt arrangements to local conditions
grammar: 因地制宜 describes adapting the same activity's placement to the two expressly different sites.
note: A chengyu about fitting measures to local conditions; it does not imply fixed traits of a region's residents.

sentence: 小林说晚间上课方便，因为六点已下班；小周却只能白天来，因为晚间要照看孩子。老师在答复中写：“合适的上课时段因人而异，这两位的安排不同，先分别确认，不能替所有学员选定晚间。”
meaning: vary according to the individual
grammar: 时段因人而异 predicates variation relative to the two people's explicitly stated availability.
note: A fixed four-character expression. Here the variation concerns schedules, not permanent personality or ability.

sentence: 这两份材料的问题不同：甲稿只把日期写错，乙稿则遗漏了参加条件。编辑先让甲稿更正日期，再请乙稿补全条件后重审，并解释：“处理要因事制宜，不能把两种问题都当成改一个数字就能解决。”
meaning: adapt the handling to the particular matter
grammar: 因事制宜 describes choosing different handling according to the two specified types of defect.
register: Formal written or considered professional explanation.
note: A four-character expression about fitting the response to the matter. Conversation can say 看具体是什么问题，再决定怎么办.

sentence: 小林已经能独立读懂短文，主要想练习解释理由；小周认识的字少，需要先练基本阅读。老师给小林安排问答练习，给小周准备有注音的短段落，说：“这次要因材施教，练习随目前的需要调整，以后再看进展。”
meaning: adapt teaching to learners' actual abilities and needs
grammar: 因材施教 describes differentiated instruction based on the two explicitly stated current learning needs.
note: A chengyu concerning how to teach. It does not rank permanent intelligence. 注音: pronunciation annotation.

sentence: 三位读者都能读出说明里的字，却都问“这里的‘他’是谁”。我据此只修改人物指代，并补写姓名，没有重写其他步骤。编辑说：“这次修改有的放矢，针对的是已经发现的指代问题。”
meaning: direct one's effort at an identified target or problem
grammar: 修改有的放矢 evaluates the stated revision as directed at the actual identified problem.
note: A chengyu evoking shooting an arrow at a target. 的 is dì here; the expression concerns purposeful targeting.

sentence: 我原想把通知的字全部放大，小林检查后指出：“字看得清，问题是没有写集合地点。”我于是补上“南门”，请两位读者查看，两人都找到了集合信息。小林说：“补地点才是对症下药，改的是实际缺失的信息。”
meaning: choose a measure that addresses the actual problem
grammar: 对症下药 characterizes the repair that addresses the established omission rather than the proposed unrelated size change.
register: Common figurative explanation in problem solving.
note: A chengyu with a symptom-and-remedy association; this context is about editing, not medical treatment.

sentence: 我发现两份表格还写着上个月的月份，便怀疑不止一人沿用了旧文件；随后查完十份，八份都有这个问题，制表人也确认用了旧模板。同事说：“这次你算是见微知著，从两处小错发现了这批表格中较普遍的模板问题。”
meaning: discern a larger tendency from small indications
grammar: 算是见微知著 gives a qualified assessment of noticing a larger batch-level problem from the initial small signs; later checking supplies confirmation.
register: Evaluative written or reflective professional language.
note: A chengyu contrasting small indications with a more evident larger matter. Small signs alone do not guarantee a general conclusion. 模板: reusable template.

sentence: 小林只试读了十二篇说明中的一篇，那篇有两个生词，便说“这十二篇都太难”。我把其余十一篇交给小林，提醒：“只凭一篇评价全部，是以偏概全；其他篇还没读，先不能断定它们也难。”
meaning: generalize improperly from a limited part to the whole
grammar: 是以偏概全 evaluates the actual move from one examined text to a claim about all twelve.
register: Critical discussion of evidence and conclusions.
note: A chengyu criticizing the scope of a generalization; it does not show that the unexamined texts are easy.

sentence: 我的原话是：“我赞成先试一个月，但是否长期实行，要看试用结果。”同事只转述“我赞成”，并说我已支持长期实行。我指出：“删掉试用期限和后面的条件，是断章取义；我没有作出长期承诺。”
meaning: distort the meaning by taking words out of their qualifying context
grammar: 是断章取义 evaluates the supplied selective retelling against the complete original statement.
register: Critical discussion of quotation or reported speech.
note: A chengyu about meaning distorted through removal from context. Selecting a passage is not automatically distortion.

sentence: 我把“无偿借用”中的“偿”只理解成“偿还”，以为机器不用归还。小林指着完整约定“不收借用费，周一归还”解释：“这里免的是费用，不是归还。”我承认：“是我望文生义，没弄懂这个词在约定里的意思。”
meaning: misinterpret an expression from its surface wording or characters
grammar: 望文生义 describes the speaker's acknowledged mistaken character-based interpretation, corrected by the complete local terms.
register: Discussion of reading and interpretation errors.
note: A chengyu warning against unsupported surface interpretation. Here 无偿 waives the fee and does not transfer ownership.

sentence: 发言记录写着：小林说“先确认场地”，小周说“再决定人数”。我写纪要时把前一句记到小周名下，后一句记到小林名下。核对原记录后，我承认这是张冠李戴，随即把两句的发言人改了回来。
meaning: attribute something to the wrong person through a mix-up
grammar: 这是张冠李戴 identifies an actual two-person attribution reversal; the correction changes attribution rather than the quoted wording.
note: A chengyu evoking putting one person's hat on another. 冠 is guān in this expression.

sentence: 草稿先把“参与”定义为“到场听或发言”，后面却写“十人都参与了，所以十人都发了言”。我评注：“这里偷换概念，后半句把‘参与’改成了‘发言’，原来的定义不支持这个结论。”作者承认前后含义不一致，答应修改，尚未改完。
meaning: shift the meaning of a key term within an argument
grammar: 偷换概念 criticizes the demonstrated change in the term's meaning between the premise and conclusion.
note: A four-character critical expression. The demonstrated semantic shift does not by itself establish a deliberately deceptive motive.

sentence: 小周说：“十个人都报名了，就写十个人已经出席吧。”我回答：“报名和出席不能混为一谈；名单只能说明十人登记，活动还在明天，到场人数要等现场记录。”小周随后把摘要改为“十人报名”。
meaning: conflate distinct matters or statuses
grammar: A和B不能混为一谈 rejects treating registration and actual attendance as the same status.
note: A chengyu for conflation. Here the relevant distinction is documented registration versus a future attendance event.

sentence: 甲组借用教室的请求只缺一个联系人姓名，乙组的请求连日期和用途都没写。负责初查的小林说：“不能一概而论地说两份都只需补姓名；甲组补姓名即可交审，乙组还须补日期和用途，两份都尚未获准。”
meaning: make one blanket judgment without distinguishing different cases
grammar: 不能一概而论地说…… rejects the supplied uniform judgment while preserving the different missing information in each request.
note: A fixed idiomatic expression often used with 不可 or 不能; distinguishing cases does not itself grant approval.

sentence: 编辑组先在一个班试用了新的交接表，四次交接都写清了已完成和待处理的项目。负责人提议：“可以以点带面，先让另外两个班参考这四份记录，再按各班分工试填；是否适用，还要听他们的反馈。”两个班尚未开始试用。
meaning: use experience at a particular point to support broader development
grammar: 可以以点带面 introduces a proposed extension from one actual trial site to two further groups; it does not report completed wider adoption.
note: A fixed four-character expression: 点 evokes the initial site and 面 the wider scope. Broader success remains to be tested.

sentence: 报告起初只写“交接常常延迟”。我先列出三次实际延迟的时间，再核对消息，发现三次都没有约定接收人，发送者和接收者也各自确认不知道该找谁。修改后的分析由表及里，从交接延迟的现象写到这三次共同缺少接收人安排的问题。
meaning: proceed from outward manifestations to an underlying relation
grammar: 分析由表及里 describes the progression from documented late handovers to the independently checked shared arrangement gap.
register: Written analysis or explanation of an analytical method.
note: A fixed expression with an outside-to-inside association. The underlying arrangement is checked here rather than guessed from appearances.

sentence: 练习约定“带笔并领到纸才可入场，两项齐全即可入场”。老师解释：“只有笔还不够，只有纸也不够；两样都有，就符合这次入场条件。”我觉得这段解释深入浅出，把两项共同构成条件的关系讲清了，也保留了只适用于本次练习的范围。
meaning: explain a substantial point in accessible language
grammar: 解释深入浅出 evaluates how an actual explanation makes the combined-condition relation accessible without deleting either requirement.
register: Appreciative assessment of teaching, writing or explanation.
note: A chengyu praising accessible explanation of a substantive point; it does not merely mean short or lacking detail.

sentence: 小林说：“如果这间屋子确实只有六个座位，而我们要求十人同时坐下，那么它就不符合我们的座位要求。”我评价：“这个推理言之成理，但‘只有六个座位’目前只是房东的说法，还没现场核实，不能把推理合理当成现场情况已证实。”
meaning: have reasons that make sense; be reasonably argued
grammar: 推理言之成理 evaluates the supplied conditional reasoning, while the premise's factual accuracy remains unverified.
register: Considered evaluation of an argument or explanation.
note: A chengyu expressing reasonable argumentation. It does not independently verify the premises.

sentence: 供应者在电话中说：“二十份材料我肯定全送到了，一份也没少。”我在记录中写：“对方言之凿凿，但接收人目前只确认收到十八份；余下两份是否另放，尚待双方核对。”我没有把供应者的确定语气当成送齐的证据。
meaning: speak with emphatic assurance that one's claim is true
grammar: 对方言之凿凿 characterizes the supplier's emphatic assertion, not the recorder's endorsement of its accuracy.
register: Descriptive reporting, often with distance from the asserted claim.
note: A chengyu describing definite, assured assertion. The wording can suggest strong grounds without establishing that those grounds actually exist.

sentence: 小林在活动报告中写道：“二十位报名者全部到场。”我核对了当日签到记录，实际到场十二人，另外八人明确回复没有来；这句话言过其实，应把到场人数改成十二人。
meaning: exaggerate beyond the actual facts
grammar: 话语或描述言过其实 evaluates wording against the facts it describes.
note: Here the exaggeration concerns attendance, not the number registered.

sentence: 这项服务标为“逐字校对”，约定检查正文中的每一个字；工作人员却只看了标题，承认正文一个字也没检查。我认为，这次提供的“逐字校对”名不副实。
meaning: fail to live up to a stated name or description
grammar: 某项服务名不副实 compares its stated description with its actual provision.
register: Critical assessment in discussion or reports.
note: 副 here means match or correspond to. The criticism is limited to this service encounter.

sentence: 我们把这次活动叫作“双向讲评”：先由我读小林的文章并提建议，再由小林读我的文章并提建议。两轮都完成后，我们各自收到了具体意见，这次的“双向讲评”确实名副其实。
meaning: truly match the stated name or description
grammar: 某项活动名副其实 affirms that its actual features match its description.
note: The expression confirms the two-way format here; it does not rate the quality of every suggestion.

sentence: 十位读者试读后，八位说日期容易找到，两位说还要找一会儿。我把“人人都能立即找到日期”改为“多数试读者觉得日期容易找到”；小林说，后一种评价恰如其分，既没夸大，也没抹去八人的肯定。
meaning: apt and proportionate; neither overstated nor understated
grammar: 评价恰如其分 assesses whether the wording fits the supported degree.
note: 分 is fèn in this expression. The revised wording remains limited to the ten trial readers.

sentence: 上次我完全没提醒交稿时间，两位同事因此忘了；这次我又每五分钟催一次，打断了大家写作。我反省说：“过犹不及，毫无提醒和催得太频繁，在这两次安排里都不妥。”
meaning: going too far can be as problematic as falling short
grammar: 过犹不及 can stand as a concise assessment followed by the relevant comparison.
note: Here 犹 means like. The comparison concerns two unsuitable reminder practices, not a numerical law.

sentence: 上版通知漏写了日期，我建议增加一次日期核对；小林却提出以后只核对日期，地点和费用都不看了。我说：“这样矫枉过正，补上日期检查，不能变成放弃其他必要检查。”
meaning: overcorrect an error; go too far in making a correction
grammar: 这样矫枉过正 criticizes an excessive corrective proposal.
register: Critical discussion of revisions or policies.
note: The proposed response goes beyond repairing the actual omission; it has not been implemented.

sentence: 这张通知的主要目的是让来访者知道时间和地点，花纹只是装饰。小林为了让花纹完整，提出删掉地址；我不同意：“为了装饰牺牲必要信息，这是本末倒置。”
meaning: reverse the proper priority of essentials and secondary matters
grammar: 这是本末倒置 identifies an inversion of the stated essential and supporting roles.
note: 本 and 末 evoke the essential basis and a secondary part. The front specifies which is which.

sentence: 我们约好先把十一点前要交的名单核对完，名牌颜色下午再选。我却一直讨论颜色，名单到十点五十分还没开始核对；我承认这次主次不分，马上停下颜色讨论，先处理名单。
meaning: fail to distinguish primary from secondary matters
grammar: 主次不分 evaluates a failure to distinguish the stated priorities.
note: This fixed four-character expression concerns prioritization; it does not by itself explain why the mistake happened.

sentence: 十分钟后要开门，先得搬走堵住入口的箱子；下周课程的主讲人也很重要，但今天下午确认还来得及；杯子颜色则可以最后再选。协调人说：“这些事要分清轻重缓急，不能只看哪件最先被提出来。”
meaning: relative importance and urgency
grammar: 分清轻重缓急 means distinguishing importance and urgency when ordering tasks.
note: Importance and urgency are separate considerations: confirming next week's main presenter is important but less immediate here.

sentence: 这次整理采用的顺序是先按日期分类，再核对姓名，最后装订；三个人都按这个顺序完成了各自的一册。负责人说：“这次按部就班地做完了，至于下次是否换方法，还要另作比较。”
meaning: follow an established sequence step by step
grammar: 按部就班地加动词 describes following the established order.
note: The expression can describe orderly work or criticize inflexibility; this sentence merely reports following the stated sequence.

sentence: 四位学员只有晚上有空，两位学员晚上要值班，只能上午参加。我们借到同一间教室的两个时段，统筹兼顾不同学员的时间需求，把同一内容安排在上午和晚上各讲一次，让六人都能选到合适时段；课程内容没有增加。
meaning: coordinate the whole arrangement while considering different needs
grammar: 统筹兼顾不同需求 describes coordinating the overall arrangement while considering the specified needs.
note: The front shows which needs are accommodated and which course content remains unchanged.

sentence: 我只问了三个问题：何时开课、在哪里上课、材料由谁提供。小林的回复逐一给出周六九点、二楼教室和由教师提供材料；就我问的这三项而言，这封回复面面俱到，没有遗漏。
meaning: cover every relevant aspect
grammar: 就某个明确范围而言，面面俱到 bounds the completeness assessment.
register: Description or evaluation of coverage; sometimes critical in other contexts.
note: Coverage is complete for the three questions, not for every conceivable course detail.

sentence: 这次装订练习规定，每桌所需工具只有剪刀、尺子和胶水；我逐桌检查，四张桌上这三样都已摆好。就这份工具清单而言，各桌所需的工具一应俱全，练习用纸则由学员自带。
meaning: have the complete set of required items
grammar: 某处所需物品一应俱全 describes the presence of the complete specified set.
note: 应 is yīng in this whole expression. The completeness claim covers the listed tools; paper is a separate arrangement.

sentence: 按我们与受访者的约定，使用这份访谈记录前，取得本人授权和删去姓名这两项缺一不可；两项都做到以后，还须核对引文，不能立即发布。现在授权已收到，姓名还没删。
meaning: every specified item is necessary; none can be omitted
grammar: 这两项缺一不可 states the necessity of each named condition.
register: Explanatory requirements within an explicit agreement.
note: Necessity does not establish sufficiency: quotation checking is also required here.

sentence: 这台投影仪没有电池，拔掉电源就会停止工作；明天的演示又必须用它投出图像。因此，对这次演示来说，持续供电是必不可少的，我们还得确认教室插座能用。
meaning: indispensable for the stated purpose
grammar: 某物是必不可少的 identifies an indispensable component for an explicitly bounded task.
note: The claim concerns this specified device and demonstration, not every kind of presentation.

sentence: 晚课学员下课后到同一食堂吃饭，食堂按下课时间准备热餐；这周晚课延后半小时，食堂也把供餐时间延后半小时。课程安排与供餐安排息息相关，调整其中一项时需要通知另一方。
meaning: be closely interconnected
grammar: A与B息息相关 describes a close relationship between the named matters.
note: The expression is figurative; it does not refer to literal breathing here.

sentence: 我们得先选定照片，才能按照片内容写说明；说明核对完，排版员才能把图片和文字放在一起。前一步的结果是后一步的依据，这三个环节环环相扣，不能把未选定的照片直接送去排版。
meaning: have each successive link connected to the next
grammar: 环节环环相扣 describes explicit connections or dependencies between successive links.
note: The links here are selection, caption writing and layout; a list in time order alone would not establish this dependence.

sentence: 这段说明写道：“认出按钮上的字，只是操作的第一步；还要理解每个按钮的作用；进一步，还要根据不同任务选择合适的按钮。”三个层次从识字推进到理解，再推进到应用，论述层层递进。
meaning: advance through successive levels
grammar: 论述层层递进 describes successive development along the stated argumentative dimension.
register: Explanatory writing and commentary on organization.
note: The progression concerns recognition, understanding and application, rather than a mere chronological list.

sentence: 我去年写分摊房租的文章，先展示一个实际分歧，再比较两种算法；今年写分摊水费，也先展示实际分歧，再比较两种算法。两篇文章的解释方法一脉相承，讨论的费用却不同。
meaning: continue the same identifiable line or approach
grammar: 方法或思路一脉相承 identifies a shared continuing line between earlier and later work.
note: The continuing line here is an explicitly repeated explanatory method, not biological descent or an unstated historical tradition.

sentence: 我们约定，不经作者同意不改署名；征集时保留作者自填的名字，编辑时先问本人，发布前又逐人确认。从征集到发布，我们一以贯之地遵守这项原则，没有替任何人擅自改名。
meaning: apply one principle consistently throughout
grammar: 一以贯之地遵守某项原则 describes consistent adherence to that principle throughout the stated stages.
note: 擅自 means acting without the relevant authorization. The front supplies the principle and its application at each stage.

sentence: 小林上午说：“我昨天只在一点到两点之间使用过教室。”下午再问，小林仍说只用了这一小时。两次说法在使用时段上前后一致，不过我们还没有查教室记录，不能因此认定时段已经核实。
meaning: be consistent across earlier and later statements
grammar: 说法在某方面前后一致 restricts consistency to the specified proposition.
note: Consistency between statements does not itself verify their truth.

sentence: 小林先说：“我昨天只给小周发过这份文件，没有发给其他人。”随后又说：“昨天我还把同一份文件发给了小陈。”我指出：“你这两句话说的是同一天、同一份文件，却自相矛盾，需要先说明哪句有误。”
meaning: contradict oneself; contain mutually incompatible statements
grammar: 两句话自相矛盾 identifies incompatible claims within the same person's account.
note: The exclusive recipient claim and the additional recipient claim cannot both hold under the explicitly shared scope.

sentence: 小林答应：“明天中午前，我把三张图发给你，不附上作者姓名。”第二天十一点，我收到了三张图，附件里也没有姓名；就这次约定而言，小林言行一致，至于图片能否采用还要再看。
meaning: have one's actions match one's stated commitment
grammar: 某人言行一致 compares actual conduct with the person's supplied words.
note: The appraisal concerns this fulfilled commitment, not every aspect of the person's character.

sentence: 同事问我是否赞成取消讨论，我其实反对，却怕当场争论，回答：“我完全赞成。”后来我向同事说明真实立场，并承认：“刚才我口是心非，那句赞成不能代表我的意见。”
meaning: say one agrees while privately holding the opposite view
grammar: 某人口是心非 describes a discrepancy between spoken assent and an expressly established inner position.
note: The speaker explicitly reports both the opposing view and the false assent; politeness alone would not establish insincerity.

sentence: 朋友请我谈谈新排版，我心里觉得文字太挤，却脱口说：“非常漂亮，我特别喜欢。”朋友追问后，我承认刚才言不由衷，真实意见是减少装饰、留出行间空白，并为没有直说而道歉。
meaning: say words that do not express one's true feelings or view
grammar: 承认自己言不由衷 explicitly owns the mismatch between words and the stated genuine view.
note: Often overlaps with 口是心非; here the speaker admits that the praise did not express the actual assessment.

sentence: 我答应读完两篇介绍再提意见，却只看了标题，就回复“都很好”。同事问到正文时，我承认：“我只是想赶快结束这件事，刚才敷衍了事，根本没有完成答应的阅读。”随后我重新打开了两篇文章。
meaning: handle something perfunctorily just to get it over with
grammar: 敷衍了事 describes inadequate handling undertaken merely to finish the matter.
note: 了 is liǎo in 了事. Reopening the texts does not establish that the promised reading has now been completed.

sentence: 小组指定我逐张核对四张收据，我一张也没看，就在检查栏填了“无误”。负责人询问后，我承认：“我想填个‘无误’来应付检查、逃避核对责任，完全是在敷衍塞责。”四张收据现在仍待核对。
meaning: perform a duty perfunctorily to evade responsibility
grammar: 敷衍塞责 evaluates perfunctory treatment of an explicitly assigned duty.
register: Strong criticism in professional or written contexts.
note: 塞 is sè in this expression. The evasion purpose is explicitly admitted, and the checking remains unfinished.

sentence: 甲乙两组已共同答应核对这笔费用，发现差额后，甲组却说“让乙组查”，乙组又把材料退回，说“还是甲组查”。两组后来承认，都想把这项已接受的工作推给对方；负责人要求停止推诿扯皮，先共同把差额查清。
meaning: pass responsibility back and forth instead of handling a matter
grammar: 停止推诿扯皮 requests an end to reciprocal responsibility shifting.
note: The criticism concerns evasion of accepted work, not every legitimate handover between teams.

sentence: 三位编辑已约定，所有日期统一写成“十月二十三日”这种格式；实际合稿时，三人却分别写成“10月23日”“10/23”和“23日”。三人承认明知约定却各行其是，现在要先统一格式再交稿。
meaning: each follow one's own approach despite a shared arrangement
grammar: 多人各行其是 describes each following a separate preferred approach.
note: The issue here is ignoring an explicitly accepted shared format, not independent judgment in every situation.

sentence: 通知组和接待组本来需要先确认同一个开放时段，却没有交换安排：通知组发出“下午开放”，接待组只排了上午值班。负责人指出，两组各自为政，导致对外通知和接待安排脱节，需要共同重定时段。
meaning: act independently without the coordination a shared undertaking requires
grammar: 各组各自为政 criticizes separate action where coordination is required.
note: 脱节 means failing to connect or coordinate. The expression does not require a literal government context.

sentence: 这次编册，小林负责核对日期，小周负责排版，我负责最后汇总；今天小林交来已核对的日期，小周交来完成的版面，我也汇总成一份文件。大家各司其职，印刷则另约明天处理。
meaning: each perform the duties of one's own role
grammar: 大家各司其职 distributes performance across the explicitly assigned roles.
note: 司 here means take charge of. Completion is supported for the three named duties; printing remains future.

sentence: 小林能独立画示意图，但今天只有一小时；小周不会画图，却能搬材料。我们说好各尽所能，小林用这一小时画好了一张图，小周搬来了两箱纸，没有要求两人做同样的事。
meaning: each contribute as fully as one's abilities and means allow
grammar: 大家各尽所能 emphasizes contributions suited to each person's stated capacity.
note: It does not require identical tasks or equal quantities of output.

sentence: 为把入口布置清楚，小林建议用箭头并画好了箭头，小周建议把桌子排成两行并已照此摆好，我建议增加问询牌并写好了牌子。我们三人群策群力，已经完成入口布置，接待工作还没开始。
meaning: pool everyone's ideas and efforts for a shared task
grammar: 多人群策群力 combines contributions of ideas with practical effort.
note: Each person's suggestion and corresponding completed action are supplied.

sentence: 原草案只写“周六办讲座”，没有地点和提问安排。小林建议写明二楼教室，小周建议留十分钟提问，我把两条意见都补进草案；这次集思广益，让草案更具体了，但是否采用还要全组讨论。
meaning: draw on multiple people's ideas to improve a proposal
grammar: 集思广益 describes using different supplied ideas to improve the matter under consideration.
note: Improving the draft does not establish group approval or implementation.

sentence: 文字组先交出核对过的说明，版面组据此排图；发现一条说明太长，两组又一起缩短了这条说明。两组通力合作，按约交出了完整样稿，正式印刷还未开始。
meaning: cooperate with combined effort toward a shared goal
grammar: 双方通力合作 describes coordinated effort toward their stated shared outcome.
note: The complementary work and joint repair produce a sample draft, not a printed edition.

sentence: 我和小林都赞成先办一场免费体验课，但我主张以后继续免费，小林主张以后收费。我们决定求同存异，先按共同意见准备这一次体验课，长期收费问题下周再谈，谁也没有撤回原来的主张。
meaning: seek common ground while retaining unresolved differences
grammar: 求同存异 separates actual shared ground from a specified continuing disagreement.
note: The shared next step does not erase either person's longer-term position.

sentence: 甲组缺尺子，却多出三支铅笔；乙组有备用尺子，正缺铅笔。两组商量后互通有无，甲组借出两支铅笔，乙组借出一把尺子，双方都已收到，约好活动后归还。
meaning: exchange complementary resources to meet each other's needs
grammar: 双方互通有无 requires actual provision in both directions within this context.
note: These transfers are reciprocal loans, not gifts or an ownership exchange.

sentence: 小林的现场笔记记全了日期，却没画展台位置；小周的示意图标清了位置，却漏写日期。我们对照两份材料，取长补短，用笔记补上图中的日期，用图补明笔记中的位置，形成了一份同时记有日期和展台位置的记录。
meaning: use complementary strengths to remedy specific weaknesses
grammar: 对照不同材料，取长补短 describes using complementary informational strengths to remedy specified gaps.
note: The strengths and gaps belong to these two records, not to the creators' overall character or ability.

sentence: 我给平时直接交流的同组同事看一则两句通知：“明天上午十点开会。请带上各自的记录。”草稿末尾我写了“不吝赐教”，随即觉得对这次普通同事交流太郑重；我说明自己只是想请大家对通知提意见，换成平常的话就是“请提意见”，现在还在等回复。
meaning: please offer comments or suggestions
grammar: 请 precedes 提意见 to request comments; it does not report that any comments have been received.
register: Natural interpretation of an unnecessarily deferential formula in this routine peer exchange.
note: 不吝赐教 courteously asks for guidance or comments. Here the writer chooses plainer wording for familiar team peers; the formula is not universally inappropriate.

sentence: 熟悉的同学小林请我帮看一段短稿：“周六我们先在教室集合，再一起去看展。”小林在稿后写“敬请斧正”，又说：“我们平时直接说话就好，我只是想请你指出这段写得不对的地方。”我理解这里的普通说法就是“请指正”，还没有开始修改。
meaning: please point out and correct errors
grammar: 请指正 requests error identification and correction without asserting completed review.
register: Natural interpretation of an elevated textual-correction formula between familiar classmates.
note: 敬请斧正 is a deferential request for correction of one's writing. The classmate explicitly prefers ordinary wording for this exchange.

sentence: 我擅长整理讲稿，却还不会调试投影仪；小林熟悉设备，也愿意负责播放。我们商量后决定扬长避短，由我整理文字，小林操作设备，今天先按这个分工试讲。
meaning: use one's strengths while avoiding one's weaknesses
grammar: 扬长避短 describes choosing how to work in light of identified strengths and weaknesses.
register: Common in professional discussion and practical advice.
note: Here 长 and 短 refer to strengths and weaknesses. 调试: adjust and test equipment.

sentence: 我们办纸艺展，既想让邻居方便来看，又担心作品淋雨。比较两处场地后，我们选择了同样靠近住宅楼的室内教室；这是趋利避害的选择，但还得另行确认教室费用。
meaning: seek benefits and avoid harm
grammar: 趋利避害 can describe the considerations guiding a choice.
note: The named benefit is convenient access; the avoided risk is rain reaching the paper artworks. Other conditions remain to be checked.

sentence: 小林希望在现场提问；小周也想参加这次讨论，但出差只能线上参加。我们让现场讨论同时在线上进行；当天小林在现场提出了自己的问题，小周也在线上参加了完整讨论。就满足这两个愿望而言，这个安排确实两全其美。
meaning: satisfy both aims satisfactorily
grammar: 某个安排两全其美 evaluates an arrangement that accommodates both stated aims.
register: Common in discussion of practical arrangements.
note: The expression concerns the two named aims; it does not establish that every feature of the event was ideal.

sentence: 以前送完这批书要跑三趟，运费共三十元，往返共用一小时；这次我们合并成一趟，书的总数不变，实际只花十元和二十分钟。合并运输既省钱又省时间，真是一举两得。
meaning: achieve two benefits through one action
grammar: 一举两得 connects one measure with two distinct benefits.
note: Both benefits are observed here: lower transport charges and less travel time, with the book quantity unchanged.

sentence: 上个月给书架贴好分类标签后，小周说：“这样就能一劳永逸，以后再也不用整理书架了。”上周又收了二十本新书，还得分类放好。我提醒小周：“标签只是方便找书，日常整理还是省不了。”
meaning: settle a matter permanently through one effort
grammar: 能一劳永逸 presents a claimed lasting solution; the following response can challenge that claim.
register: Common in discussion of solutions, often under qualification or negation.
note: The speaker's permanent-solution claim is challenged by an actual recurring need; the expression does not guarantee permanence.

sentence: 纸塔已经搭到最后一层，只差固定顶部；我急着拿去展示，没做这最后一步，刚一移动，整座纸塔就散了。眼看就要完成却功亏一篑，我只好取消当天的展示。
meaning: fail just short of success through a final unmet step
grammar: 功亏一篑 describes failure when an undertaking is close to successful completion.
note: The omitted final fastening causes this near-complete project to fail. No historical account is needed to understand the contemporary expression.

sentence: 我花了三个小时测量展台，把所有尺寸只记在一张纸上，没有留副本；后来纸掉进水里，全部数字都糊得无法辨认，也没有人记得那些尺寸。这次制图的准备前功尽弃，我们只能重新测量。
meaning: have earlier effort rendered useless
grammar: 前功尽弃 evaluates the loss of the useful results of earlier effort.
register: Expressive narrative or review of a setback.
note: The loss is confined to the recorded measurements needed for this drawing; it is not a claim that the person learned nothing.

sentence: 我这个月的全部收入是两千元，房租、伙食和交通三项支出分别是一千元、一千元和三百元，此外没有别的收支。支出比收入多三百元，已经入不敷出，缺口怎么补还没决定。
meaning: have income insufficient to cover expenditure
grammar: 入不敷出 compares income with expenditure over the same stated period.
note: The complete monthly account has 2,000 yuan of income and 2,300 yuan of expenses. No borrowing or additional income is asserted.

sentence: 这个月，我们在原有服务之外增加了一次付费讲解，实际收到二百元；又与邻组共用教室，比原来的单独租用方案少付五十元。我们用这两项办法开源节流，至于下月能否继续，还要看报名和场地情况。
meaning: increase sources of income and reduce expenditure
grammar: 用某些办法开源节流 requires both an income-side and an expenditure-side measure.
note: The expression figuratively pairs opening a source with restricting an outflow; here both financial measures actually occurred.

sentence: 这次做六份学习材料，预算只有一百元。我比较了三家店的报价，花六十元买了纸，又付了二十元打印费，没买可有可无的装饰，留下二十元备用。为了不超预算，我这回确实精打细算了一番。
meaning: calculate and plan spending carefully
grammar: 精打细算 can take aspect marking and a bounded activity expression such as 一番.
note: The assessment concerns this occasion's comparisons, purchases and reserve, rather than a permanent personal virtue.

sentence: 这次活动实际收到的全部费用是二百元，全部支出是纸张八十元、场租一百元、交通二十元，没有欠款，也没有其他收支。这次活动正好收支平衡，没有结余，也没有缺口。
meaning: have income and expenditure balance
grammar: 收支平衡 predicates equality between the stated income and expenditure totals.
note: A financial collocation; its four-character form alone does not make it a chengyu.

sentence: 展览原定今天同时开放四个服务点，每处按我们的安排都要一人值守，却只有三人到场；我们无法让四处同时有人，开门前临时撤掉了一处。面对这几项同时发生的需要，人手确实捉襟见肘。
meaning: have resources too limited to cover competing needs
grammar: 人手捉襟见肘 describes insufficient staffing relative to simultaneous needs.
register: Common figurative use in professional or written explanation.
note: Literally evokes pulling a garment into place only to expose an elbow; here it describes staffing constraints.

sentence: 修好活动室屋顶的报价是六千元，原有资金一千元，还差五千元；今天又收到十元，缺口仍有四千九百九十元。这十元虽然也是帮助，但对解决这个资金缺口来说只是杯水车薪，维修仍然无法按原计划开工。
meaning: a remedy far too small for the problem
grammar: 对某个问题来说只是杯水车薪 evaluates the inadequacy of a proposed or actual remedy.
note: The expression evokes a cup of water against a cartload of burning fuel. It evaluates the amount's adequacy, not the donor's worth or goodwill.

sentence: 我的说明原来写着：“讨论时，每个人都有发言机会，也可以选择不说。”小林建议在结尾加一句：“有机会，不等于必须开口。”我照此加上后，试读的同事说，这句话起了画龙点睛的作用，一下点明了自愿发言这个重点。
meaning: make a work effective through a small addition clarifying its key point
grammar: 起了画龙点睛的作用 evaluates a small addition's key clarifying contribution.
register: Common praise in writing review or explanation.
note: Literally evokes adding the eyes to a painted dragon; here the added sentence highlights an already stated distinction.

sentence: 这次联合讲解中，六位讲者都要用同一份演示文件，小林负责把六人的资料汇总并排好顺序；文件没准备好，六段讲解就都无法按计划进行。因此，这项汇总工作在整场活动中举足轻重。
meaning: have major importance and consequences
grammar: 在某个安排中举足轻重 bounds the importance assessment to that arrangement.
note: Here the expression concerns the consequence-bearing role of one shared preparation task, rather than literal bodily movement.

sentence: 小周八点半要在车站坐最后一班车，从教室走过去要十五分钟；若讨论八点二十分结束，就赶不上了。我在会上说：“这个交通限制不容忽视，我建议八点前结束，再请大家确认。”
meaning: be too important to overlook
grammar: 某个因素不容忽视 evaluates its material relevance to the decision.
note: This is an assessment of a consequential constraint, not a claim of legal authority. The proposed ending time remains subject to confirmation.

sentence: 这次线上讨论只通过一个网络平台进行，也没有电话接入的办法；对远程参加的人来说，网络连接是不可或缺的。现在教室已经借好，但网络还没测试，不能就此认定准备齐全。
meaning: indispensable; unable to be omitted
grammar: 某物是不可或缺的 identifies an indispensable component for a bounded purpose.
register: Common explanatory written or spoken language.
note: The necessity concerns the explicitly chosen participation method; obtaining a classroom alone does not establish readiness.

sentence: 我们现在只比较哪只箱子能装下这三十本书；两只都已经试过，都能装下。一个贴黄标签，一个贴蓝标签，但标签颜色不影响容量，对眼下这个比较来说无足轻重。
meaning: have little importance or bearing on the matter
grammar: 对某个比较来说无足轻重 limits the assessment of importance to a named question.
note: The color difference has little bearing on the capacity comparison; the expression does not dismiss all possible uses of labels.

sentence: 另外五位同事各忙了五个小时，我只帮着贴了十分钟标签。我说：“和你们投入的时间相比，我这点贡献微不足道。”小林回答：“时间虽少，标签也确实帮上了忙。”
meaning: very small and hardly worth mentioning
grammar: 贡献微不足道 can express the speaker's modest assessment of a bounded contribution.
register: Common evaluative wording, including modest self-presentation.
note: The judgment belongs to the speaker and concerns this contribution in the stated comparison, not anyone's total worth.

sentence: 这张内部便条只用来告诉同事明天几点、在哪儿集合，时间和地点已经写得准确清楚。纸边有没有装饰线，对传达这两项信息来说无关紧要，我决定先不画了。
meaning: have no material importance for the matter
grammar: 对某个目的来说无关紧要 specifies what the detail does not materially affect.
note: Only the decorative line is judged unimportant for the stated purpose; accuracy of the meeting information is retained.

sentence: 海报的日期、地点和参加条件都核对过了，文字也清楚；只是第二行的字距比第一行略大。我认为这点排版差别无伤大雅，不影响读者理解安排，今天可以先发给组员试读。
meaning: not spoil the overall effect despite a minor flaw
grammar: 这点差别无伤大雅 evaluates a limited imperfection against the overall result.
note: The small spacing flaw leaves the checked facts, conditions and legibility intact. 字距: spacing between characters.

sentence: 小周家中水管突然漏水，先关水处理，十分钟后已处理妥当，却又过了十分钟才告诉我们不能来。我说：“你先处理漏水无可厚非，但事情处理完后应该尽快通知，免得大家空等。”小周同意这个提醒。
meaning: not warrant severe blame
grammar: 某个做法无可厚非 can acknowledge an understandable action while retaining a specific criticism.
note: This expression does not necessarily remove every ground for criticism; the notification issue remains explicit.

sentence: 我们事先明确说好，这次帮忙完全自愿，拒绝也不会影响以后参加活动。小林因已有安排谢绝了邀请；我认为这个选择无可非议，不能又以不肯帮忙为由责怪小林。
meaning: give no grounds for objection or blame
grammar: 某个选择无可非议 rejects grounds for criticizing that specified choice.
note: The judgment concerns refusal under this explicit voluntary arrangement, rather than an unrestricted judgment about every aspect of conduct.

sentence: 约定是周五把十份材料交给小林；交接记录写明周五交付十份，收件人签名也是小林。我逐项核过后说：“就日期、数量和收件人这三项而言，这份记录无可指摘；材料内容还没检查。”
meaning: have no fault open to criticism
grammar: 就某些已核对的项目而言无可指摘 restricts the favorable assessment to those items.
note: The explicit scope is three checked record fields; the statement does not certify the unexamined materials.

sentence: 小林的理由是：“只需给这八人每人一把椅子，原有六把，新借两把，八把都检查过能用，所以数量正好够。”我认为，就椅子数量这一点，这段论证无懈可击；至于房间是否够大，还需另外测量。
meaning: have no exploitable weakness or gap
grammar: 论证无懈可击 evaluates an argument as having no vulnerable gap within its specified scope.
note: The assessment belongs to the narrator and concerns the complete chair-count argument, not the room's overall suitability.

sentence: 我向小林说明：“周二这笔三十元付款有据可查，电子收据和付款记录都已作为附件发给你，请对照日期和金额。”小林说附件还没打开，会在下午核对；目前不能说对方已经查过。
meaning: have evidence available for checking
grammar: 某件事有据可查 identifies available supporting records without asserting that the addressee has examined them.
note: A fixed four-character phrase about checkable evidence; availability and completed verification remain distinct.

sentence: 工具组全员同意了一套借用办法：“先查库存；有货就登记姓名并借出，无货就告知缺货。”办法已经写在借用台旁，新来的值班同事也有章可循，不必临时猜该怎么处理。
meaning: have established rules or procedures to follow
grammar: 办理某事有章可循 indicates that an applicable procedure is available.
note: 章 refers to rules or established procedures here. The front supplies the group's own agreed procedure, not an external law.

sentence: 组里约定先查库存，有货才登记姓名并借出。今天小林来借一把剪刀，我查到两把可用，记下小林的姓名后交出一把。这次我是照章办事，没有省去约定的检查和登记。
meaning: handle a matter according to established rules
grammar: 照章办事 describes handling conducted in accordance with an applicable stated procedure.
note: The completed handling follows this group's specific stock-checking and registration agreement.

sentence: 新教室的月租已经问清，水电费却还不知道，而我们要比较的是每月总支出。三人同意，长期租用的事先从长计议，周五拿到费用明细后再讨论；并不是决定放弃租用。
meaning: allow fuller deliberation before deciding
grammar: 某事先从长计议 defers immediate decision for fuller consideration.
note: The missing cost information and scheduled return to discussion distinguish deferral from abandonment.

sentence: 打印机坏了，今天又必须给十二位组员各发一份安排，我们决定先手写十二份。这只是权宜之计，解决今天的发放问题；下周怎样稳定印制，仍要等维修报价出来后再定。
meaning: a temporary expedient suited to immediate circumstances
grammar: 只是权宜之计 identifies a temporary measure while limiting its longer-term adequacy.
note: The expedient addresses today's twelve copies; the continuing printing arrangement remains unsettled.

sentence: 还有五分钟就要给来访者演示，屏幕上却仍是已经作废的旧安排。负责人说：“当务之急是换上确认过的新文件；明天才要寄出的感谢信可以等演示后再写。”
meaning: the most urgent task at present
grammar: 当务之急是某事 identifies the task requiring first attention now.
register: Common prioritization in spoken or written explanation.
note: The immediate display problem is contrasted with a separately timed, deferrable task.

sentence: 十二位组员五分钟后就到，教室里却只有十把椅子；小林从隔壁借来两把，已经搬到教室，让每人都有座位。这两把椅子解了我们的燃眉之急，后续长期借用的事还没谈。
meaning: an acutely pressing immediate need
grammar: 解了某人的燃眉之急 describes meeting an immediate pressing need.
register: Common figurative description of urgent help.
note: No literal fire is involved. The actual two-chair addition resolves the immediate seating gap, without establishing a continuing loan.

sentence: 还有十分钟就要按名单分组，名单里却把同一个人写了两次，另一个报名者没有列入。主持人说：“核对名单的事已经迫在眉睫，请先把这两处查清，再开始分组。”
meaning: be imminently pressing
grammar: 某事已经迫在眉睫 presents a task or problem as immediately pressing.
note: The imminent grouping time and actual duplicate and omission support urgency; the check is requested rather than reported complete.

sentence: 送餐车十分钟后出发，我们刚发现给司机的纸条把收货地址写错了。负责联络的小林说：“发送正确地址刻不容缓，我现在就联系司机；菜单颜色的事等会儿再说。”司机还没回复。
meaning: admit no delay; require immediate action
grammar: 某项行动刻不容缓 evaluates delay as unacceptable under the stated circumstances.
register: Strong urgency in professional or written explanation.
note: The assessment belongs to the assigned contact person. Initiating contact does not establish that the driver has received the correction.

sentence: 两组先一起选好篇目，逐位确认参加时间，又借到教室并合练两次；正式联合朗读那天，所有人按约到场，整场顺利完成。我在总结里写：“前面的准备一步步做足，这次合作的成功可说是水到渠成。”
meaning: have success follow naturally once the necessary preparations are in place
grammar: 某个结果可说是水到渠成 assesses how a result followed accumulated preparation.
note: The writer evaluates one completed cooperation after specified preparations; the idiom does not guarantee every prepared event will succeed. 篇目: selected text titles.

sentence: 小林参与了全部三次筹备讨论，也整理了大家提出的问题；其他五位成员都同意由小林主持明天的交流，小林也接受了。在我看来，这个安排顺理成章，但主持的实际效果还要等明天才能知道。
meaning: follow naturally and reasonably from the circumstances
grammar: 某个安排顺理成章 evaluates it as naturally fitting the stated grounds.
note: Agreement and relevant preparation support the narrator's judgment; they do not establish a universal appointment rule or guarantee performance.

sentence: 我借教室时答应过，使用后由我把桌面擦干净。今天活动结束，我正准备擦桌子，同事说不用了；我回答：“这是我已经答应的事，由我收拾是理所当然的，不必另找人替我。”
meaning: be reasonable and to be expected
grammar: 某事是理所当然的 presents it as reasonable or expected on specified grounds.
register: Common evaluative explanation; can be forceful.
note: The expectation rests on the speaker's own explicit promise, rather than a universal cultural duty. Cleaning has not yet been reported complete.

sentence: 我原以为这次换成大号字以后，十位试读者都会更容易找到日期；结果八位说更清楚了，两位却说日期被挤到下一页，反而难找。这个版面变化是我始料未及的，我决定先修改再试读。
meaning: not have anticipated the development beforehand
grammar: 某个变化是某人始料未及的 identifies an outcome that the named person had not anticipated.
register: Common retrospective written or spoken explanation.
note: The writer's universal expectation is contrasted with all ten actual responses, including the two adverse cases.

sentence: 我把内部日程草稿作为附件发给熟悉的同组同事小林，在消息里写：“日程草稿已附上，明天下午两点讨论，敬请垂鉴。”小林读了消息，问后面的客气话是什么意思。我解释：“在这条日常消息里，用‘请看看’就自然多了；我只是请你读一下附件里的日程，没有请你批准，也没有请你修改。”小林还没打开附件。
meaning: please have a look; a natural reading request corresponding here to 敬请垂鉴
grammar: 请 plus reduplicated 看 requests a brief look; it does not itself request approval or revision.
register: Natural ordinary request to a familiar peer.
note: Recognize 敬请垂鉴 as an elevated respectful request to examine or read here. The writer selects plainer wording for this routine internal message.

sentence: 我给熟悉的同事小周留了一张日常便条，开头写“小周台鉴”，正文是“明天讨论改到下午三点，地点不变”。小周问“台鉴”是什么意思，我解释：“这是正式书信里请收信人阅读的客气说法；这里写‘请看’就够了，不是请你批准改时间。”
meaning: please read; the addressee-facing request conveyed here by 台鉴
grammar: 请看 requests attention to the written content without asking for authorization.
note: 台鉴 is a respectful formal letter-address formula. Its elevated register is a poor fit for this writer's routine familiar-coworker note, rather than a universal grammatical error.

sentence: 线上讲座原定由小周主讲，开场前一分钟，小周突然断网；我还没拿到讲稿，就被请去临时接替他讲解，一时措手不及，只能先向听众说明情况，请大家稍等。
meaning: be caught unprepared and unable to respond in time
grammar: 措手不及 describes the affected person's immediate inability to respond adequately.
note: The sudden disruption and missing script establish the lack of preparation; surprise alone is not enough.

sentence: 昨天我们把两份午餐送错了楼，已经没法让收餐的人按原定时间吃上饭。今天我已经给每袋饭加上楼号，又在交给司机前逐袋核对过。我说：“现在亡羊补牢，是为了不再送错，昨天耽误的时间可补不回来。”
meaning: remedy a lapse after a loss to prevent further trouble
grammar: 亡羊补牢 refers to corrective action taken after something has gone wrong.
register: Common retrospective discussion and practical advice.
note: The sheep-and-enclosure image supports repairing a weakness after a loss; it does not mean undoing the loss already incurred.

sentence: 明早九点就要向新同事介绍设备，我今晚才第一次打开说明书，对着机器练习开关和换纸。我承认这是临阵磨枪，至于明天能不能讲清楚，还得看实际表现。
meaning: prepare at the last moment for an approaching task
grammar: 临阵磨枪 characterizes preparation immediately before the relevant challenge.
note: The weapon-preparation image is figurative here. Last-minute preparation does not itself establish failure.

sentence: 这三个月每次活动都有足够的志愿者，现场也一直运转正常。我还是建议居安思危，先问好两位愿意临时替班的人，免得以后有人突然请假时无人接手；目前还没有缺岗。
meaning: consider possible trouble while conditions are satisfactory
grammar: 居安思危 links a satisfactory present situation with attention to possible future trouble.
note: The possible staffing gap remains a contingency, rather than a prediction that trouble must occur.

sentence: 我是今天讨论的主持人，大家同意由我调整各环节的时长，必要时增加五分钟提问，但不能晚于四点结束。三点四十，我见两位新成员举手，就见机行事，把尚未开始的自由交流缩短五分钟，留出提问时间，四点准时结束。
meaning: act according to an emerging opportunity or situation
grammar: 见机行事 describes choosing an action in response to the situation as it develops.
note: 机 refers to the occasion or opportunity here, not a machine. The host's discretion has an explicit time boundary.

sentence: 我负责今天的试课，事先得到老师同意：投影不能用时，可以改发纸稿，但不能改教学内容。上课后投影突然坏了，我随机应变，把备用纸稿发给六位学员，仍按原来的三个问题组织讨论。
meaning: adapt one's response to changing circumstances
grammar: 随机应变 describes adapting an action when circumstances change.
note: 随机 does not mean choosing randomly in this expression; the response addresses a specific change.

sentence: 几位学员课间总爱互相比较自己拍的照片，还主动问别人为什么这样取景。老师因势利导，征得大家同意后，把下次练习改成两人交换照片、各提一个具体问题；评价重点仍是说明理由。
meaning: guide an existing tendency toward a useful purpose
grammar: 因势利导 describes guiding a tendency that is already present.
note: The learners' actual voluntary exchanges supply the existing tendency; the teacher channels it into a defined exercise.

sentence: 最近三次读书活动，都有参加者主动带来自写的短文，请大家提意见。我们顺势而为，在下个月的活动中增加一个自愿分享短文的时段，原来的共读时间不变；新时段有没有人报名，还不知道。
meaning: act in line with an existing favorable development
grammar: 顺势而为 links an action to an already developing situation.
note: A fixed four-character expression. Following a favorable development does not guarantee uptake or success.

sentence: 两组都只能在当天五点以后各练习一小时，需要用同一间教室，原以为教室六点关门，一直排不开。管理员确认当天可以用到七点后，两组立刻同意第一组用五点到六点、第二组用六点到七点，时间冲突便迎刃而解；器材怎么分还没谈。
meaning: be readily resolved once the key difficulty is addressed
grammar: 问题或困难迎刃而解 presents a difficulty as readily resolved.
note: The blade image is figurative. Only the scheduling conflict is resolved; equipment allocation remains open.

sentence: 我原想独自接下三十人的晚餐，当天从能进入厨房到开饭只有一小时；试做后发现自己的小厨房一小时最多只能做好十份，而客人必须同时开饭。我决定知难而退，向邀请我的朋友说明不接这次整场供餐，但仍愿意帮忙备菜。
meaning: withdraw after recognizing a difficulty
grammar: 知难而退 describes withdrawing in response to a recognized difficulty.
register: Narrative and evaluative discussion; approval depends on context.
note: Here it is a bounded capacity-based decision, without a judgment about permanent courage or potential.

sentence: 我们的小组已经租下展厅，布展时才发现还得另付两千元才能使用现场灯光。继续办展会超过大家同意的预算，取消又会失去已付且约定不退的一千元租金。我说：“现在进退两难，先把两种代价列清楚，再一起决定。”
meaning: face serious difficulties both in continuing and in withdrawing
grammar: 进退两难 evaluates both proceeding and retreating as difficult.
register: Common discussion of difficult practical choices.
note: The two costs are explicitly supplied; the expression does not identify which option should be selected.

sentence: 我答应周六上午陪父亲搬家，也答应同一时间替同事看店，直到今天核对日期才发现重了。两边都还没找到别人，我左右为难，分别说明自己的错误，请他们给我一点时间一起找替代安排，目前谁也没答应改时间。
meaning: be caught in a difficult choice between competing demands
grammar: 左右为难 describes difficulty accommodating competing sides or demands.
note: 左右 is figurative here. Both commitments and the speaker's difficult position are explicit.

sentence: 我已经开办了六次写作课，接下来四次的课费也收了，却没有提前备课，现在每次都忙到深夜。我对搭档说：“现在骑虎难下，继续这样教我吃不消，突然停课又会打乱学员的安排；我们得尽快和他们商量一个补救办法。”
meaning: find it difficult to stop an undertaking already begun
grammar: 骑虎难下 concerns difficulty withdrawing from an undertaking already in progress.
register: Figurative narrative and candid practical discussion.
note: The tiger image conveys difficult disengagement; no literal or historical episode is required.

sentence: 我是今天演出的现场负责人，大家事先同意，遇到设备故障由我决定是否暂停。开场时音箱冒出烟，我当机立断，立即暂停演出，请负责设备的同事切断电源；恢复时间还没确定。
meaning: make a prompt decisive choice at the critical moment
grammar: 当机立断 describes an actor making a timely decisive choice.
note: The decision maker's authority and the actual urgent trigger are stated; later resumption remains undecided.

sentence: 朋友问我是不是只要再加五十元就肯出租相机。我斩钉截铁地回答：“不租，这周无论加多少钱都不租，我每天都要自己用。”朋友说知道了，没有继续问。
meaning: firm and unambiguous in expression
grammar: 斩钉截铁地回答 describes the firmness and decisiveness of a response.
note: It characterizes the stated manner and position, rather than independently verifying truth or sincerity.

sentence: 我们比较了两个展厅，仍没选定，便一致授权负责场地的小林在三百元以内作最后决定。小林核实甲厅租金是二百八十元后，一锤定音：“就订甲厅，明天我去办。”大家接受了这个决定，预订手续还没办。
meaning: settle a pending issue with a final decisive decision
grammar: 一锤定音 describes a decisive contribution or decision settling the issue.
note: The hammer image marks final settlement of the choice; booking remains a separate future action.

sentence: 我答应周五给小林送回修好的桌子。后来有人出更高的工钱，请我周五去装柜子，我还是拒绝了：“一诺千金，既然答应了小林，我就得给原来的活留足时间。”今天才周三，桌子还没修完。
meaning: a promise carries great weight and should be honored
grammar: 一诺千金 can be invoked as a standard for taking one's promise seriously.
register: Emphatic personal commitment and appreciative assessment.
note: 千金 evokes great value rather than a literal payment. The speaker values the promise, but its fulfillment is still future.

sentence: 小周周一答应周四中午前送来六张活动照片，今天周四十一点就把六张都交给我了。我当面说：“你这次言而有信，数量和时间都跟答应的一样。”照片是否采用，还要大家另行讨论。
meaning: keep one's word
grammar: 言而有信 evaluates conduct as matching a stated promise.
note: 这次 confines the appraisal to this fulfilled promise; it does not certify every future commitment.

sentence: 我昨天答应今天九点到店里替小林看店，却明知有这个约定，仍去参加十点才结束的聚会，也没有提前告诉小林。我十一点到店后认错：“这次是我言而无信，让你一直等着。”小林要求以后有变化先联系。
meaning: fail to keep one's word
grammar: 言而无信 evaluates a failure to honor one's stated promise.
note: The speaker acknowledges this particular breach; the expression need not become a permanent whole-person judgment.

sentence: 上午小周说：“明天那两张空桌子免费借给你。”下午又说：“我改主意了，不付租金就不借。”桌子仍空着，也没有新增费用。我指出：“你先答应免费，现在又加条件，这样出尔反尔，我们原来的安排怎么办？”小周还没回答。
meaning: go back on one's earlier word or position
grammar: 出尔反尔 characterizes reversal of one's own earlier stated position or commitment.
note: Both statements are visible. The criticism concerns the changed commitment, with the response still pending.

sentence: 我们请小林统一安排今天的布展顺序。现场条件没变，小林九点让大家先剪纸，十点改成先搬桌子，十一点又要求先排练，大家只好不断停下手头的事。我说：“这样朝令夕改，三件事都难做完，能不能先把顺序定稳？”
meaning: change instructions repeatedly within a short period
grammar: 朝令夕改 criticizes frequent changes to issued instructions or decisions.
note: 朝 and 夕 evoke rapid changes rather than requiring one literal morning-and-evening pair.

sentence: 我说要学会整理调查结果，却只看了教程第一页，照着排好一列数字，就把后面的比较和说明全放下了。我承认：“这次只是浅尝辄止，离能独立写分析报告还远。”
meaning: stop after only a superficial initial attempt
grammar: 浅尝辄止 describes stopping before pursuing an activity in depth.
register: Reflective writing and usually critical assessment.
note: The tasting image is figurative here; the criticism is limited to this learning attempt.

sentence: 我做纸架时原打算等胶干、放书试稳以后再交给同事，却想赶紧交货，胶还湿着就抱出去，接缝立刻开了。我承认自己急于求成，省掉了等待和试验。
meaning: be too impatient for quick success
grammar: 急于求成 describes excessive eagerness to obtain the result quickly.
note: The speaker's wish to finish quickly and the omitted preparation establish the criticism. 接缝 means the joined seam.

sentence: 我负责课程安排，为了这周多收几份报名费，把答应老学员的答疑时段改成了新课推介，结果那次辅导没有进行。我反省：“这次急功近利，眼前多收了两百元，却牺牲了原先承诺的后续辅导。”
meaning: pursue immediate gains at the expense of longer-term considerations
grammar: 急功近利 criticizes excessive pursuit of quick achievements or immediate benefits.
note: The organizer explicitly owns the revenue-seeking motive and identifies the actual service sacrificed. 推介 means introducing or promoting an offering.

sentence: 我刚开始学家具设计，连桌腿长度都常算错，却只想着下个月独立设计整套教室家具，老师安排的测量和画图练习也不做。我承认自己这次好高骛远，先把眼前的基础练好再说。
meaning: pursue unrealistically lofty goals while neglecting present foundations
grammar: 好高骛远 evaluates goals and conduct as detached from the present practical foundation.
note: 好 is hào in this whole expression. The speaker criticizes this current plan, rather than ambition or future potential generally.

sentence: 上次我只说要把活动做大，却连参加者的时间都没问。这次我决定脚踏实地，先逐个询问四位愿意参加的人，记下可用时段，再按已经确认的人数安排第一次练习；现在四人的时间都问清了。
meaning: proceed concretely, steadily and realistically
grammar: 脚踏实地 can describe a practical approach before naming concrete actions.
register: Common positive advice or reflective assessment.
note: The feet-on-solid-ground image is figurative; actual completed inquiries substantiate this occasion's practical approach.

sentence: 讨论是否延长阅览室开放时间时，我们先问了八位使用者，发现其中五位需要晚间时段，又向两位值班同事确认了周三晚间有空。我认为这次筹备工作做到了求真务实，可以先提周三试开一晚的方案，而不是直接宣称每天都能延长；具体值班还要征得同事同意。
meaning: seek factual grounding and focus on workable action
grammar: 求真务实 evaluates an approach combining factual inquiry with practical action.
note: A conventional four-character expression. The assessment rests on specified inquiries and supports only a proposed one-evening trial.

sentence: 上周我还不能独立给照片写说明，这周已经有三条不用老师修改了，但另外两条仍漏了日期。老师说：“这三条有进步，再接再厉，把剩下两条也补完整。”我还没开始改。
meaning: continue making further efforts after progress
grammar: 再接再厉 commonly encourages continued effort after an achievement or improvement.
register: Common encouragement in learning and professional feedback.
note: The encouragement follows actual progress and leaves the remaining revision unfinished.

sentence: 为了找回误装进别的箱子的原稿，我把今天能用的三个小时全用上，查遍了由我保管的六只箱子，也问了两位搬箱子的同事，还是没找到。我对作者说：“今天我已经竭尽全力，但不能说稿子一定还能找回来。”
meaning: exert all one's available effort
grammar: 竭尽全力 describes the actor's maximum effort, independently of success.
note: The effort claim belongs to the speaker and is limited to today's stated resources and search.

sentence: 我愿意为周日的公益演出不遗余力：这两天所有空闲时间都用来联系场地，能联系的三处都问了，也提出用自己可支配的八十元帮助承担场租。现在只有一处还在考虑，我还不能向演员保证演出能办。
meaning: spare no available effort
grammar: 为某事不遗余力 identifies the undertaking receiving the effort.
note: The speaker scopes the effort to this event and available means; it does not create unlimited future obligations.

sentence: 我很想亲自辅导全部十位新学员，可每天只有一小时能留在教室，昨天帮完三个人就必须离开了。我对老师说：“想把十个人都照顾到，我现在确实力不从心，能不能请另一位同事分担？”老师还没答复。
meaning: have capacity or resources fall short of one's intention
grammar: 力不从心 contrasts a wish with the ability or means available to carry it out.
register: Common candid explanation of a limit.
note: The speaker's willingness remains explicit; the limitation concerns the present ten-person workload.

sentence: 我特意早半小时到服务点，原想早点办完，好赶回去上课，结果那天机器故障，我等了一个小时才办好，反而迟到了。我说：“这回事与愿违，早到并没有让我按计划回去。”
meaning: have the actual outcome run contrary to one's wishes
grammar: 事与愿违 contrasts the actual course or outcome with the intended one.
note: The intended timely return and actual lateness are explicit; the idiom itself does not establish a general causal rule.

sentence: 我请同事指出这张通知最影响阅读的问题。同事指出日期太小，我放大以后，六位试读者都能找到日期了。我说：“这次修改就适可而止吧，先保留现有内容，不再另加装饰，免得挤压正文。”
meaning: stop at an appropriate point or extent
grammar: 适可而止 describes stopping once an appropriate extent has been reached.
note: The stopping judgment is tied to the specified readability task and actual reader check.

sentence: 这封给全组的说明只需交代延期原因，不宜展开同事的私人情况。我写“因一位成员临时有事，讨论改到下周”，关于那位成员的事便点到为止，没有写姓名和具体缘由；新日期留待大家确认。
meaning: touch on a point without developing it further
grammar: 关于某事点到为止 limits how fully that matter is developed.
register: Discussion of explanation, feedback or writing.
note: A fixed expression for limited treatment. The stated reason is briefly acknowledged rather than omitted entirely.

sentence: 我们想请场地方把原来六百元的租金降到预算内的五百元，对方已经同意，另提醒我们这个价格只保留到今晚。搭档还想再压到四百元，我说：“不如见好就收，五百已经达到我们的目标，继续谈可能错过保留期限。”我们还没付款。
meaning: stop after obtaining a favorable result rather than press further
grammar: 见好就收 recommends stopping after a satisfactory gain.
note: The achieved price reduction and possible expiry motivate the advice; neither payment nor a worse outcome is asserted.

sentence: 讨论下个月是否合办课程时，我说明自己每周只能教一晚，小林也说清楚场地只免费提供四次。我们开诚布公地谈了各自能承担的部分和不能答应的条件，最后只同意每周一晚先试办四次，之后再议。
meaning: speak openly and candidly about relevant facts and positions
grammar: 开诚布公地谈 introduces an open, candid discussion.
note: Both parties' relevant limits are actually stated; openness here does not mean unrestricted disclosure of private information.

sentence: 小周和我是常一起进货的熟人，平时互发的消息都很随意。今天小周写：“明早九点我去取货。顺颂商祺。”我问最后一句是什么意思，小周解释：“就是祝工作顺利，是给你的祝福，没有另外的事要你办。”
meaning: wish you success and smooth progress in your work
grammar: 祝 introduces the desired good outcome as a wish.
register: Natural interpretation of a ceremonious business-correspondence closing in this casual exchange.
note: 顺颂商祺 conveys business-related good wishes. Here its ceremony exceeds the familiar partners' usual message style; it adds no task or guaranteed outcome.

sentence: 我和小林是多年的朋友，平时写便条也不用客套话。这次小林留给我的便条写着：“书已经寄出。敬颂时祺。”我问结尾的意思，小林说：“就是祝你安好，我这回把结尾写得太郑重了。”
meaning: wish you well
grammar: 祝你安好 expresses a general good wish directed to the recipient.
register: Natural interpretation of a formal correspondence closing in a brief friendly note.
note: 敬颂时祺 is a formal closing conveying good wishes. The sender identifies its unusually ceremonious fit in this particular friendship exchange.

sentence: 小林和我是多年的朋友，平时说话很随意。今天小林来我家看我做的木船，我迎上去说：“你这一来，真是蓬荜生辉。”小林问这句客气话什么意思，我解释：“你来做客，我很荣幸。”
meaning: feel very honored
grammar: 我很荣幸 identifies the host as the person feeling honored, with the visit as its stated cause.
register: Natural interpretation of a ceremonious host-side formula between familiar friends.
note: 蓬荜生辉 uses a humble-home metaphor to express honor from a guest's visit. It does not describe literal brightness or merely unspecified pleasure.

sentence: 小周是我熟悉的同事，我们平时互发消息都很简短。今天小周写：“谨此奉告：我明早八点到店。”我问怎么写得这么郑重，小周解释：“换成平常的话就是，跟你说一声，我明早八点到店。”
meaning: just let you know
grammar: 跟你说一声 can preface a brief update addressed to the listener.
register: Natural familiar-peer counterpart to a solemn informing formula.
note: 谨此奉告 respectfully and solemnly introduces information. Both versions retain the same sender, next-morning eight-o'clock arrival and destination.

sentence: 整理记录时，小周对我说：“第二份照旧。”我没听明白具体要保留什么，便问：“嗯？你是说日期不改，还是整份都不改？”小周回答：“只保留日期，人数要改成六人。”
meaning: hmm?; requesting clarification of what was said
grammar: Questioning 嗯 introduces an explicit clarification request rather than assent.
note: The selected reading is rising-tone syllabic ng; other supported pronunciation variants also occur.

sentence: 小林告诉我：“昨天那场讨论后来改到晚上了。”这件事我之前完全不知道，惊讶地追问：“哦？原来通知的下午三点没开，那最后是几点开始的？”小林回答：“晚上七点。”
meaning: oh?; expressing surprise and inviting further information
grammar: Questioning 哦 precedes a genuine follow-up inquiry about newly reported information.
note: The selected ó reading differs from realization ò.

sentence: 我一直盼着今晚听朋友介绍新作品，出门前却收到朋友取消活动的消息。我失望地叹了口气，对室友说：“嗨，准备了这么久，今晚还是听不成了。”室友问我要不要一起散步，我还没决定。
meaning: ah; a sigh expressing disappointment
grammar: 嗨 introduces the speaker's explicitly reported disappointed reaction.
note: This sigh and the familiar greeting can share hāi; their interactional functions differ.

sentence: 一起整理书架时，小周指着我反复调整的三本书，开玩笑说：“它们搬家搬得比我还勤，今天已经换了四次住处。”我被这个说法逗乐，笑着回应：“哈，还真换了四次！这回按书名排好就不动了。”
meaning: ha!; a short amused laugh
grammar: 哈 is a short laughter interjection before the speaker's verbal response.

sentence: 电话里，小周说：“把那两份留到明天。”我听见了这句话，却不知道指哪两份，便追问：“啊？你说的是已经核对过的，还是桌上没核对的？”小周回答：“桌上没核对的那两份。”
meaning: huh?; asking for clarification
grammar: Standalone questioning 啊 introduces a clarification request about the preceding instruction.
note: The selected á reading is distinct from neutral sentence-final a.

sentence: 同事说：“这份介绍应该先写清楚活动时间，颜色可以最后再选。”我赞同这个先后次序，回应：“就是，先让读者知道什么时候来。”同事接着提议把报名人数也删掉，我明确表示不同意。
meaning: exactly; emphatically agreeing with the preceding point
grammar: Standalone 就是 affirms the preceding point; it does not identify a noun or introduce a reformulation.

sentence: 小周说：“这个教室离车站近，大家走过来只要五分钟。”我承认路程方便，回答：“那倒是，不过租金比我们约定的上限还高二十元，我还不能同意订。”小周说要再问问能否便宜些，尚未得到答复。
meaning: that is true, admittedly
grammar: 那倒是 grants the preceding particular point before a separate objection.

sentence: 熟悉的同事问：“你不肯接第三篇，是嫌这项工作没意思吧？”我纠正道：“才不是，我很想继续写，只是周五前最多还能完成两篇，第三篇确实赶不及。”同事回答：“明白了，我再找别人接第三篇。”
meaning: certainly not; firmly rejecting that characterization
grammar: 才 reinforces denial of the immediately preceding characterization; it does not mark late timing or a low quantity.
note: Bù normally changes to bú before shì in connected speech; the reading records lexical tones.

sentence: 一起编辑照片说明的朋友说：“我先把这张合照发到大家都能看的页面吧。”我知道其中一人还没同意公开，马上提醒：“可别现在就发，先问过照片里每个人。”朋友回答：“好，我先去问，暂时不发。”
meaning: be sure not to; reinforcing a warning or caution
grammar: 可 reinforces 别 before the specified action being cautioned against.

sentence: 两位同事问我：“介绍活动时，是先讲收费，还是先讲做什么？”我提出自己的建议：“要我说，先用两句讲清活动内容，再说明每人二十元，读者可以先了解活动，再看费用。”两人说要比较两种顺序，还没选定。
meaning: if you ask me; in my opinion
grammar: 要我说 frames the following recommendation as the speaker's opinion rather than an instruction to request speech.

sentence: 两份草稿都写明周六下午两点开始；甲稿只写“来参加”，乙稿另写“也可以只听，不必发言”。在我看来，乙稿更能说明参加方式，但这只是我的判断，还要请实际读者试读。
meaning: in my view; as I see it
grammar: 在我看来 explicitly attributes the following evaluation to the speaker.

sentence: 一起排练的朋友问：“你觉得我这次讲解已经能直接上台了吗？请告诉我具体问题。”我回答：“说实在的，内容我都听明白了，可两处停顿把句子断开了，我建议先把这两处练顺。”朋友同意再练，尚未上台。
meaning: frankly; to be honest
grammar: 说实在的 prefaces a candid, specifically scoped response to the actual request for feedback.
note: The formula frames the response; it does not independently prove sincerity.

sentence: 我们三人约定：“只有三人都同意，才能改讨论时间。”今天两人同意，一人还没回复。反过来说，只要还有一人没表示同意，就不能按这个约定改时间；没有回复不等于已经反对。
meaning: putting the same relation the other way around
grammar: The reformulation states the contrapositive of the supplied necessary condition without treating assent as sufficient.

sentence: 原记录写：“周六下午两点到四点，六位成员可借用教室整理照片；不得带其他人，结束后要把桌子放回原处。”我概括道：“简而言之，这两小时只供这六人整理照片，用完还须恢复桌子的位置。”
meaning: briefly put; in short
grammar: 简而言之 introduces a concise summary of the supplied record.

sentence: 同事说：“今天只需核对十个人的姓名，不查费用，也不用替他们报名。”我向接班的人概括：“一句话，今天这项任务只核对这十个人的姓名。费用核查和报名都不在其中。”接班的人确认理解，还没开始核对。
meaning: in a nutshell; to sum it up
grammar: 一句话 functions as a discourse summary marker, not a literal limit of exactly one following sentence.
note: Yī normally changes to yí before fourth-tone jù in connected speech.

sentence: 合作多年的小周问：“这次租场地，你能先垫一百元吗？不方便就直说。”我回答：“实不相瞒，我这周手头只留了六十元生活费，不能先垫；我可以帮你联系另外两位。”小周说会另想办法，尚未请我联系。
meaning: to tell you frankly
grammar: 实不相瞒 introduces the speaker's own concrete circumstance before a definite refusal.
register: Somewhat ceremonious but usable in an earnest familiar exchange.

sentence: 小周提议今晚就订这个房间。我回答：“且不说租金还没问清，光是只有四把椅子这一点，就不能满足我们六个人同时坐下的需要。价格明早再核实，现在先确认能否补两把椅子。”小周答应先问椅子的事。
meaning: setting aside for now; leaving aside
grammar: 且不说 temporarily brackets one real consideration while another independently supports the current objection.

sentence: 同事看见只有一页的培训提纲，担心内容太少。我指着列出的三部分解释：“别看提纲短，示范、独立练习和共同核对三部分都有；只是各部分用时还没定。”同事说要再看具体安排。
meaning: although it may appear; despite the apparent fact that
grammar: 别看 introduces a conceded surface feature before a counterexpectational comment; it is not a prohibition on looking.
note: 提纲: outline.

sentence: 小周说：“四个人都同意周五来，时间就定周五吧。”我把四条回复念出来：“三人说可以，第四人说还要查排班。”接着提醒：“你看，最后这条还不是同意，我们得等他确认。”小周回答：“对，先不定。”
meaning: look; directing attention to the evidence just supplied
grammar: 你看 directs the interlocutor to the significance of supplied evidence, rather than merely requesting visual inspection.

sentence: 整理完材料，小周和我聊起明天的午饭，拿起外套准备走。我想在离开前把归还钥匙的时间问清，便叫住这位熟悉的同事：“我说，钥匙明早八点交给你，方便吗？”小周回答：“方便，我八点在门口等你。”
meaning: say; a conversational preface attracting the listener's attention
grammar: Utterance-initial 我说 is a conversational attention preface, not the reporting verb of a following quotation.
register: Familiar conversational address; potentially abrupt with unfamiliar addressees.

sentence: 书面讨论中，小周提议再买六张纸。我回复：“我们六人每人只用一张，现有的六张都能用，这岂不正好够用？”见面时我把同一意思说得平常些：“现有的纸正好够，不必另买。”小周同意暂不购买。
meaning: is it not indeed; rhetorically affirming the inference
grammar: 岂不 forms a rhetorical question affirming sufficiency from the supplied complete quantities.
register: Written rhetorical reasoning; the ordinary spoken counterpart is supplied.

sentence: 我们约定收到全部三位作者的许可后才公开照片，现在只收到两份。小周提议先发，我在回复中写：“还有一位没有许可，岂能现在公开？”当面又说明：“按我们的约定，现在不能发。”小周同意等最后一份许可。
meaning: how could it be acceptable to; rhetorically rejecting permission
grammar: 岂能 challenges acceptability under the stated agreement, not physical ability to post.
register: Firm written objection with a plain spoken counterpart.

sentence: 同事问我要不要再抄一份地址。我在便条上回复：“信封上的地址已逐字核对无误，何须另抄一份？按现有地址寄出便可。”见面时我说：“不用另抄，照信封寄就行。”同事接受了建议，信还没寄。
meaning: why would there be any need to; rhetorically denying necessity
grammar: 何须 rhetorically presents the specified additional action as unnecessary.
register: Written rhetorical advice; plainer spoken wording is supplied.

sentence: 负责选版式的两位同事还拿不定主意：两版都能排下十张照片，也都符合用纸限制。我在留言中建议：“何妨各印一张，让实际读者比较？”见面时我说：“可以先各试印一张。”两人答应考虑，还没决定试印。
meaning: why not try; it would be reasonable to consider
grammar: 何妨 proposes an available option for consideration without asserting authorization or performance.
register: Written suggestion with an ordinary spoken counterpart.

sentence: 小周说我昨晚七点到八点整理材料时出去过。我回答：“那一小时我先和你核对姓名，再和你装袋，最后一起清点，全程都在这个房间，何曾出去过？”小周承认：“对，你一直在场，是我把另一个时段记混了。”
meaning: when did I ever; rhetorically denying occurrence
grammar: 何曾 rhetorically denies the event within the expressly bounded past interval.

sentence: 我们找了半小时，先查桌下，又翻了两个纸箱，仍没找到要用的那把钥匙。最后小周从外套口袋里拿出钥匙，我松了口气，说：“可算找到了，不用再等别人送备用的来。”门还没打开。
meaning: finally, with relief at a long-awaited result
grammar: 可算 precedes an actually achieved result and conveys the speaker's stated relief.

sentence: 我想请同事今晚帮忙整理，却只说：“这些材料明早就要用了。”同事问：“你是在提醒我时间，还是希望我留下？”我这才明说：“我想请你今晚再帮十分钟；不方便也没关系。”同事还没回答。
meaning: state explicitly; say directly
grammar: 明说 introduces the speaker's explicit statement of a previously indirect request.

sentence: 我和小周商量合作时，一直只说“条件还得再谈”。小周问具体卡在哪里，我决定把问题挑明：“我愿意做排版，但不能同时承担全部文字校对；校对需要另找人。”小周说要问第三位同事，分工尚未定。
meaning: bring the underlying issue into the open; state it plainly
grammar: 把问题挑明 introduces explicit disclosure of the actual previously unspecified issue.
register: Conversational negotiation and its written account.

sentence: 我昨天才请朋友帮过忙，今天又需要借一把小梯子，担心接连麻烦对方，犹豫了一会儿才开口：“你的小梯子今晚能借我半小时吗？不方便我就另找。”朋友回答：“可以，九点前还我就好。”梯子还没取。
meaning: speak up; begin making a request
grammar: 开口 marks initiating the actual request after stated hesitation, rather than literal mouth movement.

sentence: 小周事先对我说：“可以向来访的人介绍我的工作和作品，但别提我的收入。”我答应了。见面时我介绍了小周的工作和作品，对收入却闭口不谈。事后小周问我有没有提，我回答：“没有，我只讲了你同意介绍的那两项。”
meaning: keep silent about a specified topic
grammar: 对某事闭口不谈 specifies deliberate silence about one topic while other speech continues.

sentence: 我们四人的“晚间交流组”原来只在晚上见面，后来一致决定改在周末下午活动，并将小组改称为“周末交流组”。新旧名称指的仍是我们这个四人小组，原来的活动记录也继续保留。
meaning: rename; change the designation to
grammar: 将某团体改称为某名称 changes the designation of an explicitly unchanged group.

sentence: 我们五人给自办的小组定名“社区志愿服务小组”，又约定在内部表格上把全名缩写成“志愿组”。写给不熟悉这个名称的人时，先列全名，再说明短名；两种写法都指我们五人的小组。
meaning: abbreviate a written name
grammar: 把全名缩写成短名 identifies the complete name and its locally defined abbreviated replacement.

sentence: 原记录写：“小林周六下午两点到活动室，带来三张照片。”我的初稿只写“小林周六来了”。同事请我只用原记录的信息扩写，我便改成：“周六下午两点，小林带着三张照片来到活动室。”没有补写照片的作者。
meaning: expand a short draft with additional supplied detail
grammar: 扩写 names expansion of the supplied short draft using information actually present in the record.

sentence: 我的记录开头是：“我把两本书递给小周。”接下来实际发生的是小周把书放回书架，然后我关窗。老师让我按这些事实续写，我接着写：“小周把这两本书放回书架，我随后关了窗。”没有把关窗的人换成小周。
meaning: continue writing from the supplied stopping point
grammar: 续写 continues an actual opening using the supplied subsequent events and unchanged narrative voice.
